arctig-weavind-park.description: Arctig is a privately owned steel construction and engineering company based in Weavind Park, Pretoria. Established in 2015, the company specialises in structural steel design, fabrication and installation for construction and engineering applications. Arctig provides a range of manufacturing and engineering capabilities, including steel structure manufacturing, pipe fitting, specialised welding, plasma cutting, cut-to-size services, product development and contract work. This combination of design, fabrication and installation capabilities allows Arctig to support projects from the manufacturing stage through to on-site installation. The company works within the broader construction and engineering sectors and focuses on delivering steel solutions tailored to individual project requirements. Based at 141 Cresswell Road in Weavind Park, Arctig is positioned within Pretoria's established industrial and manufacturing area. Its combination of engineering expertise, fabrication capability and specialised metalworking services makes it a relevant supplier for construction companies, engineering firms, contractors and other businesses requiring professionally manufactured steel components and structures.

m-t-a-neon-signs-hesteapark.description: M T A Neon Signs is a Pretoria-based signage business located at 457 Horn Street in Wolmer. As its name suggests, the business specialises in neon signage and operates within the signage and sign-making industry. Businesses looking to improve their visibility through custom signage can use M T A Neon Signs for signage-related enquiries, with the company particularly relevant to customers interested in illuminated and neon-style signs. Its Wolmer location makes it conveniently positioned to serve businesses across Pretoria North and surrounding areas.

lc-ceilings-and-drywall-dorandia.description: LC Ceilings and Drywall is a building contractor based in Dorandia, Pretoria North, specialising in ceiling and drywall installation. The business focuses on interior construction work such as renovations, alterations and finishing, fitting ceilings and drywall partitions as part of broader building projects. It serves residential homeowners and property owners undertaking renovations or alterations, and its classification as a building contractor means it can also take on larger construction and renovation projects beyond individual household jobs. The business is listed in Pretoria's Building & Construction category, trading from 745 Ciliaris Street in Dorandia, Pretoria North. It suits homeowners planning a ceiling replacement, drywall partition or renovation, as well as property owners and contractors who need ceiling and drywall work carried out as part of a wider building or alteration project.

kolletjies-kafee-sinoville.description: Kolletjies Kafee is a neighbourhood café, convenience shop and takeaway outlet at Sinoville Corner Shopping Mall on Braam Pretorius Street, serving the surrounding Sinoville, Magalieskruin, Montana and Wonderboom communities. It offers takeaway meals and everyday convenience items, and customer reviews frequently single out its slap chips as among the best in the area, alongside dishes such as hake and chips, prego rolls and sphatlho. The café has a long-standing local character: reviews describe it as having served the community for many years, with ownership changing hands over time while it has continued operating as an independent neighbourhood business rather than a franchise. It trades from early morning into the evening on most days, making it a practical stop for breakfast, lunch, a quick takeaway or everyday essentials. Kolletjies Kafee suits locals after an affordable meal on the go as well as residents picking up convenience items close to home.

europcar-wonderboom-airport-wonderboom.description: Europcar Wonderboom Airport is a car-rental branch of the Europcar South Africa network, serving travellers who need a vehicle after flying into Wonderboom Airport as well as local Pretoria residents and businesses. The branch offers hire for personal travel, holidays, airport transfers and local transport, alongside corporate and business-rental services for companies needing vehicles for staff, clients or business trips. The branch is at Wonderboom Airport on Lintveldt Road, Annlin, Pretoria North, and is listed as a Deliver/Collect location, so delivery and collection can be arranged through the branch when booking. It is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm and Saturday from 8am to 1pm, and closed on Sundays and public holidays. It suits travellers who want to collect a rental car directly at the airport rather than travelling into central Pretoria.

makro-liquor-wonderboom-annlin-west.description: Makro Liquor Wonderboom is a dedicated liquor outlet operating alongside the main Makro store at 270 Lavender Road, Annlin West, Pretoria. superspar-renbro-hammanskraal.description: SUPERSPAR Renbro is a full-service supermarket at Shop 12, Renbro Shopping Centre, Old Warmbaths Road, Hammanskraal, offering fresh produce, an in-store bakery, butchery and deli alongside everyday groceries, pantry staples and household essentials. The store primarily serves the Hammanskraal community and surrounding residential areas, handling regular household grocery shopping and larger fresh-food purchases, and offers in-store shopping alongside pickup and delivery. It is part of the Renbro retail centre, where the same local retail group also runs Renbro TOPS. It trades from 7am to 7pm Monday to Saturday, and from 7am to 4pm on Sundays.

pep-home-centurion-lyttelton-centre-lytt.description: PEP Home Centurion Lyttelton Centre is PEP's homeware retail format, trading from Lyttelton Centre at the corner of Botha Avenue and Cantonments Road in Centurion. the-crazy-store-watermeyer-park-val-de-g.description: The Crazy Store at Watermeyer Park Shopping Centre, located at Shop 18 on Kirkia Street in Val-de-Grace, Pretoria, is a value and variety retailer offering discounted everyday products. the-office-zone-monavoni.description: The Office Zone is a flexible workspace provider based in Centurion, offering serviced and private offices, coworking spaces, virtual-office packages and meeting rooms for businesses that don't want the commitment of a traditional lease. Facilities available to tenants and visitors include fully furnished workspaces, mail handling, office cleaning, printing, telephone-answering services, staffed reception, shared kitchens, administrative support and 24-hour access, giving clients a ready-to-use office environment without managing their own premises. totalenergies-elardus-park-elardus-park.description: TotalEnergies Elardus Park is a 24-hour fuel station on Solomon Mahlangu Drive in Erasmuskloof, Pretoria, serving local residents, commuters and motorists travelling through the Elardus Park and Erasmuskloof area. As part of the broader TotalEnergies network, the station follows the brand's standard forecourt offering while serving the specific needs of the Elardus Park and Erasmuskloof community, combining fuel supply with convenience retail and vehicle care under one roof.

totalenergies-hertzog-street-motors-riet.description: TotalEnergies Hertzog Street Motors is a 24-hour fuel station at 895 Hertzog Street in Rietfontein, Pretoria, serving private motorists, commuters, local residents and commercial road users. totalenergies-moot-street-motors-daspoor.description: TotalEnergies Moot Street Motors is a 24-hour fuel station at 536 Moot Street in Daspoort, Pretoria, serving private motorists, commuters, local residents and commercial road users travelling through the area. tribeca-coffee-company-blue-valley-golf-.description: TriBeCa Coffee Company is a coffee roastery that produces and supplies roasted coffee, including blends and single-origin varieties, and is recognised as one of South Africa's larger roasting operations. This move placed the roastery within the broader Rooihuiskraal area of Centurion, where it continues to roast and distribute coffee to clients across the supply chain. With more than two decades of roasting experience behind it, TriBeCa Coffee Company has grown from its Koedoespoort origins into an established supplier serving both commercial customers, such as cafés and businesses needing bulk or branded coffee, and individual coffee drinkers seeking specific blends or single-origin options like its Kilimanjaro offering.

zaeng-consulting-and-construction-engine.description: Zaeng Consulting and Construction Engineers is a multidisciplinary engineering and construction consultancy based in Centurion, offering services across architecture, civil and structural engineering, electrical and electronics engineering, mechanical and fire engineering, project management and quantity surveying. The firm's multidisciplinary structure means clients can draw on architectural, structural, electrical, mechanical and project-management expertise within one consultancy, which can streamline coordination on projects that would otherwise involve multiple separate firms. This combination of broad technical capability and a confirmed project history positions Zaeng Consulting and Construction Engineers as an established option for developers and businesses in the greater Centurion area seeking integrated engineering and construction consulting support.

440-printers-pretoria-central.description: 440 Printers is a digital and custom printing business based in Capital Park, on Paul Kruger Street, offering printing services alongside label printing and graphic-design work. an-then-wellness-center-wingate-park.description: Anóthen Wellness Center is a holistic wellness practice in Wingate Park, Pretoria, offering acupuncture alongside a range of natural wellness products. avis-centurion.description: This Avis branch operates from the Barloworld Toyota Centurion dealership, forming part of the international Avis Rent a Car network. bedrock-boardwalk-manor.description: BedRock, headquartered at The Boardwalk Office Park in Faerie Glen, Pretoria, supplies timber support products for underground mining operations, along with dunnage used for industrial and export packaging purposes. Its product range covers timber-based support applications engineered for underground mining environments, serving mining companies and industrial customers across the sector. It also offers loading services for material cars on shaft banks, supporting the logistics of moving supplies underground. The company describes its operation as spanning the full timber and support value chain, beginning with seedlings and continuing through to the delivery of mine-ready support products. This end-to-end approach allows BedRock to manage quality and supply consistency from early-stage forestry inputs through to finished, treated products ready for use underground. Its executive office in Faerie Glen coordinates this value chain on behalf of mining and industrial customers who depend on reliable timber supply for underground operations and export-related dunnage needs.

bondev-office-park-midstream-candlewoods.description: Bondev Office Park is a commercial office development within the Midstream Estate area, Centurion, housing a range of professional and business tenants. Beyond fundraising occasions, the space accommodates a variety of gatherings suited to community organisations and private hosts looking for a venue with an established cultural identity. As a long-standing fixture for Pretoria's Portuguese and Madeiran community, Casa Social da Madeira continues to provide a setting where cultural ties are maintained through shared meals, entertainment and social occasions, while also opening its doors to broader event hire for functions, celebrations and gatherings.

cash-converters-nina-park-ninapark.description: Cash Converters Nina Park operates from Shop 21 in Nina Park Square, on the corner of Rachel De Beer Road and Grafenheim Street in Akasia. Customers visiting the store can access everyday health and beauty products alongside pharmacy services for prescription medicines, as well as clinic services typically associated with Clicks' healthcare offering, such as basic health screenings and related care. The branch's location within Mall@Reds places it among the shopping centre's established retail tenants, giving shoppers the convenience of combining pharmacy and clinic visits with other errands at the mall. As part of the national Clicks chain, the store follows a consistent format that pairs retail health and beauty products with professional pharmacy and clinic support, making it a practical healthcare and shopping destination for the local community. Its presence in Rooihuiskraal North strengthens access to pharmacy and basic health services for residents across this part of Centurion.

clicks-mamelodi-crossing-mamelodi.description: Clicks Mamelodi Crossing is a pharmacy, health and beauty retailer located at Shop H11 in the Mamelodi Crossing shopping centre on Maphalla Street, Mamelodi. The branch serves residents of Mamelodi, offering the standard Clicks retail format that pairs health and beauty products with dedicated pharmacy facilities and related clinic services. Shoppers can purchase everyday personal care, cosmetics and household health items, while the in-store pharmacy supports prescription needs and other pharmacy-related services for the local community. As part of the national Clicks chain, the branch brings a consistent retail and healthcare offering to Mamelodi, situated within an established shopping centre that draws shoppers from across the surrounding area. Its position inside Mamelodi Crossing allows customers to combine pharmacy visits with other shopping needs during the same trip, making it a convenient stop for routine health and beauty purchases. The branch's pharmacy and clinic-related services contribute to the accessibility of basic healthcare support for residents of Mamelodi, reinforcing the store's role as both a retail outlet and a local point of access for pharmacy services within the community.

agricad-pty-ltd-waltloo.description: AgriCAD (Pty) Ltd designs and manufactures agricultural implements and equipment using computer-aided engineering, with a product range covering the full farming cycle from soil preparation through to crop management and harvesting. The company serves farmers and agricultural businesses, with equipment operating across South Africa and exported to more than 14 other African countries, reflecting a broad footprint across Southern Africa and beyond. Its manufacturing facility is based on Mundt Street in Waltloo, Pretoria, where implements are engineered and produced for both domestic use and export markets. AgriCAD applies computer-aided design and engineering processes to develop implements suited to different stages of agricultural production, giving farming operations access to equipment tailored to soil preparation, planting, crop management and harvesting needs. The company has also highlighted its role as the first African agricultural-equipment manufacturer to have its implements digitally featured as a mod within the Farming Simulator video game, a distinction that has given its equipment visibility beyond the agricultural sector itself. Through its Waltloo manufacturing base, AgriCAD continues to supply farmers and agricultural businesses across a wide regional footprint, combining local manufacturing with substantial export reach into other African markets.

aimnet-meyerspark.description: AIMNET is a digital marketing and search engine optimisation consultancy offering services including SEO, content marketing, article writing, content strategy development, backlink development and competitor analysis. It serves businesses seeking to improve their online visibility and grow organic website traffic through structured digital marketing campaigns. The company's Pretoria office is based on Roos Street in Meyerspark, which forms one of several office locations the business maintains, alongside additional offices in Johannesburg, Durban and Cape Town. This multi-city presence allows AIMNET to serve clients across different regions of South Africa from a network of local offices. Its service offering centres on helping businesses strengthen their search engine rankings and content presence, combining technical SEO work with ongoing content creation and competitor benchmarking. By analysing competitor activity alongside developing backlinks and content strategy, AIMNET positions its services toward businesses wanting a structured, research-driven approach to digital marketing rather than one-off campaigns. The Meyerspark office serves as part of this broader national footprint, giving Pretoria-based clients access to the same range of SEO and content marketing services offered from the company's other regional locations.

alfie-s-menlyn.description: Alfie's is an Italian café on Hazelwood Road in Hazelwood, Pretoria, specialising in handmade Italian food prepared using a slow-food approach. Its menu features homemade pasta dishes such as gnocchi and ravioli, alongside Italian-style steaks including Fiorentina, reflecting a focus on traditional preparation methods rather than mass-produced convenience food. The café serves individuals, couples, families and groups looking for an intimate Italian dining experience, with its handmade approach to pasta and other dishes setting it apart from more generic Italian restaurant offerings. By emphasising slow food and made-from-scratch dishes, Alfie's positions itself as a destination for diners seeking authentic Italian flavours prepared with care rather than fast turnaround service. The restaurant's Hazelwood location places it within a well-established dining node in Pretoria, convenient for nearby residents as well as visitors travelling specifically for its handmade menu. Signature dishes such as the gnocchi and Fiorentina steak anchor a menu built around genuine Italian cooking traditions, making Alfie's a café suited to relaxed meals, celebratory dinners and casual get-togethers alike for anyone wanting a taste of homemade Italian cuisine in Pretoria.

arrie-nel-pharmacy-menlyn.description: Arrie Nel Serene Pharmacy is a retail pharmacy located on Winifred Yell Street in Garsfontein, Pretoria, operating on a 24-hour basis. The pharmacy serves individuals, families and residents in the surrounding area who need access to prescription medicines and general healthcare essentials at any time of day or night. Alongside its round-the-clock pharmacy services, the store offers in-store shopping for everyday health and personal care products, along with pickup and delivery options for customers who prefer not to visit in person. As part of the broader Arrie Nel Pharmacy Group, the Garsfontein branch combines the convenience of extended operating hours with a full range of general pharmacy and health product offerings. Its 24-hour availability makes it a valuable option for residents facing after-hours medical needs, whether for urgent prescription collection or general healthcare essentials unavailable at standard daytime pharmacies. The combination of in-store service, pickup and delivery gives customers flexibility in how they access the pharmacy's offerings, supporting both walk-in shoppers and those who need medicines or products brought to them. The Garsfontein location remains central to the pharmacy's role in serving its local community around the clock.

d-j-wendyhouses-jan-niemand-park.description: D & J Wendyhouses is a manufacturer of Wendy houses and timber garden structures, based in Derdepoort, Jan Niemand Park, Pretoria. The business serves homeowners and property owners seeking additional timber structures for their properties, such as garden rooms, workspaces, or extra storage space. D & J Wendyhouses is independently listed as a dedicated Wendy house manufacturer operating in the Jan Niemand Park area, building timber structures to order for residential customers in and around Pretoria. Rather than general construction or renovation work, the company specialises specifically in prefabricated timber buildings of this kind, giving property owners a straightforward way to add a standalone wooden structure to a garden or yard. The business operates from its Derdepoort premises, serving the local Pretoria market with timber Wendy houses suited to a range of residential uses.

der-zucker-backer-menlyn.description: Der Zucker Backer is a German bakery and coffee shop located in Menlyn Retail Park, on the corner of Garsfontein Road and Lois Avenue, Pretoria. The business has been associated with Pretoria since the early 1990s, having previously operated in Hazelwood before relocating to its current Menlyn Retail Park premises. Der Zucker Backer specialises in German-style baked goods, pastries and cakes, alongside coffee, breakfast and light meals, serving individuals, families and diners looking for authentic German bakery fare. Its signature offering is the Bienenstich, or bee-sting pastry, alongside a wider range of German confectionery and baked treats. Customers can visit for a sit-down breakfast or light meal, or call in for coffee and pastries to enjoy on site or take away. With roots going back more than three decades in Pretoria, Der Zucker Backer continues to serve the Menlyn area from its Garsfontein Road and Lois Avenue location.

door-2-door-digital-cc-waverley.description: Door 2 Door Digital CC is a digital printing and signwriting business operating from 1309 Starkey Avenue, Waverley, Pretoria, with roots dating back to 2006. The company provides digital printing services, signwriting artistry, and sign-making materials to individuals and businesses in need of signage and printed vinyl products. Its offering spans the design and production of signage as well as supply of sign-related materials, making it a one-stop option for businesses wanting branded signage, vehicle graphics, or other printed vinyl work. Customer feedback has particularly highlighted the quality of its vinyl products, pointing to consistent standards in the printing and material side of the business. Having operated in Waverley since 2006, Door 2 Door Digital CC has built up nearly two decades of experience in the digital printing and signwriting trade, serving the Pretoria area with both the practical printing side of signage production and the more creative, artistic side of signwriting design.

durand-m-c-les-marais.description: Durand M C is the medical practice of Dr Michiel Christoffel Durand, a general surgeon practising in Pretoria. The practice is based at Suite 16, Doctors Village, within the Life Eugene Marais Hospital complex in Les Marais, Pretoria. Dr Durand is listed by Life Healthcare as a general surgeon, and the practice serves patients requiring general surgical consultation and treatment. Operating from within a hospital-based doctors' village gives patients access to surgical consultation in close proximity to the hospital's broader theatre and inpatient facilities. As a general surgical practice, Durand M C serves the surrounding Pretoria community, including Les Marais and nearby suburbs, for patients needing to consult a general surgeon ahead of or following a procedure. Patients can find the practice at its Suite 16 rooms within the Doctors Village attached to Life Eugene Marais Hospital, one of several specialist practices operating from that address.

est-sourcing-pty-ltd-wingate-park.description: EST Sourcing (Pty) Ltd is a bursary, learnership and corporate social investment (CSI) management company headquartered in the City of Tshwane, founded in 2021. The company works with corporate partners and public and private education institutions to administer bursary and education funding programmes, helping disadvantaged students and youth access financial support for their studies. For corporate clients, EST Sourcing manages programmes that contribute toward enterprise and supplier development, as well as training-related B-BBEE scorecard points, linking social investment spend to measurable compliance outcomes. Its services bring together corporates seeking to meet B-BBEE and CSI obligations, educational institutions needing funding partners, and students and young people in need of bursary or learnership support. EST Sourcing continues to administer bursary funding in partnership with municipalities and corporate partners, positioning itself as an intermediary between funders and the students who benefit from their contributions. The company operates from Moreleta Park, Pretoria, serving clients across the broader Tshwane area and beyond.

fargomax-pty-ltd-heuweloord.description: Fargomax (Pty) Ltd is an IT services company founded in 2011 that implements, customises, integrates, and maintains SAP Business One ERP systems for small and medium-sized businesses. Its SAP Business One work covers finance, purchasing, inventory, sales, customer relationship management (CRM), projects and operations, and human resources modules, with ongoing user support once systems are live. Alongside its ERP work, Fargomax provides Bluwave integration and support, cybersecurity services, IT consulting, technical maintenance and user training. The company serves SMEs looking to automate business processes and streamline operations across departments, offering a single point of contact from initial ERP implementation through to long-term maintenance and support. Fargomax is a small team of between two and ten people, based in the Centurion area, reflecting a focused, specialist consultancy model rather than a large-scale IT vendor. Its combination of ERP implementation, cybersecurity and general IT consulting positions it as a one-stop technology partner for SMEs needing both software systems and broader IT support.

flight-centre-the-grove-pretoria-de-wilg.description: Flight Centre The Grove Pretoria is a travel agency branch located at Shop L03, The Grove Shopping Centre, on the corner of Lynnwood Road and Simon Vermooten Road in Die Wilgers, Pretoria. As a dedicated travel-agency branch within The Grove, it provides flight bookings, accommodation bookings, tours and customised holiday itineraries to customers. The branch serves holidaymakers, families, business travellers and individuals planning trips, offering in-person travel consultations for both leisure and business travel needs. Customers can book flights and accommodation separately or put together full travel packages, including guided and independent tours, tailored to their specific destinations and travel dates. Being based inside The Grove Shopping Centre gives shoppers in Die Wilgers and the surrounding Pretoria East area convenient access to a full-service travel agency while going about other errands at the centre. As part of the wider Flight Centre network, the branch draws on established travel-industry relationships to help plan and book trips of varying complexity, from simple flight bookings to multi-destination holiday itineraries.

folex-accounting-services-rooihuiskraal.description: Folex Accounting Services is an accounting and financial advisory firm based in Centurion, offering accounting, budgeting, tax advisory, financial advisory, financial analysis, financial reporting and financial accounting services. The firm also provides business and management consulting support, working with businesses and organisations that need both day-to-day accounting functions and higher-level financial and strategic advice. Folex is identified as a Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment (B-BBEE) business, a status relevant to clients seeking to work with B-BBEE-compliant suppliers as part of their own procurement and compliance requirements. Alongside its core accounting and consulting services, Folex is associated with a 'Folex Funding Market' offering, extending its activities beyond traditional accounting into funding-related services. Based in the Rooihuiskraal North area of Centurion, the firm serves businesses and organisations across the wider region that require ongoing accounting, tax and financial management support, as well as more strategic financial and business consulting input to guide broader decision-making.

gloss-glo-midstream-midstream-estate.description: Gloss&Glo Midstream is a beauty and nail studio located at Shop 11, Shopping on Ridgeway, Midstream Estate, Centurion. The salon specialises in nail treatments including acrylic nails, gel polish, hard and builder gel, rubber-base systems, nail art, manicures and pedicures. Beyond nails, Gloss&Glo offers a wider range of beauty and skincare services, including waxing, brow and lash treatments, and aesthetic treatments such as facials, chemical peels and microneedling. The studio serves individuals seeking a combination of nail care, general beauty treatments and more advanced aesthetic skincare under one roof. Gloss&Glo Midstream is open on weekdays from 08:00 to 18:00 and on weekends from 08:00 to 17:00, giving clients flexibility to book appointments outside typical working hours. The salon was recognised as winner of the 'Best of Midstream' award in the Beauty category for 2024, reflecting its standing among beauty providers in the Midstream area. Clients in Midstream Estate and surrounding Centurion suburbs can access both routine nail maintenance and more involved skincare and aesthetic procedures at this single Shopping on Ridgeway location.

ibhubesi-information-technologies-cc-con.description:
Ibhubesi Information Technologies CC is an information technology company based in Constantia Park, Pretoria, providing IT products and related services to businesses and organisations. The company supplies IT hardware and technology products, along with associated support, to clients that require this kind of equipment and ongoing technical assistance.

Ibhubesi's operations from 558 Coert Steynberg Street, Constantia Park, are independently confirmed through the State Information Technology Agency's (SITA) accredited reseller database, which lists the company among suppliers approved to provide IT products within government procurement channels. This accreditation indicates the company meets the standards required to supply technology hardware and services to public-sector clients, alongside any private-sector business it serves.

Older government supplier records corroborate the same Constantia Park address, pointing to a long-standing presence at this location. Together, these independent sources confirm both the nature of Ibhubesi's business as an IT products and services provider and its base of operations, making it a verified supplier of IT hardware and technology products to businesses and organisations in the Pretoria area.

imbawula-civil-projects-amandasig.description:
Imbawula Civil Projects is a civil engineering and professional-services company offering civil infrastructure, construction and engineering consultancy services, primarily to government departments, municipalities and other organisations requiring civil engineering, infrastructure or construction work.

The company's work is independently verified through government contract records. A City of Tshwane report documents Imbawula providing professional services for water and sewer reticulation infrastructure in Andeon Extension 37, confirming its role in municipal civil engineering projects within the greater Pretoria area. Separately, the City of Ekurhuleni's awarded-bids report from April 2026 lists Imbawula as part of a panel appointed for the planning, design and supervision of roads, stormwater drainage and public-transport facilities, indicating the company's capacity to deliver multidisciplinary civil infrastructure projects across municipal boundaries.

These two independently sourced government records demonstrate that Imbawula Civil Projects operates as an established professional-services provider in the civil engineering sector, with verified involvement in water and sewer reticulation, as well as roads, stormwater drainage and public-transport infrastructure. Its client base centres on government departments and municipalities that require this level of civil engineering consultancy and project delivery, supported by direct evidence of awarded municipal contracts.

ingwane-company-sa-pty-ltd-brakfontein.description:
Ingwane Company SA (Pty) Ltd is a one-stop business-services provider based in Capital View, Pretoria, assisting small and medium enterprises and entrepreneurs with company administration, compliance, accounting, tax and digital services. The company was registered with the Companies and Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC) in 2018, and its service model is built around supporting SMMEs from initial business registration through to ongoing compliance and operational support.

Its services span company registration, CIPC and SARS annual returns, B-BBEE certification support, Central Supplier Database and Construction Industry Development Board registrations, UIF and COIDA registrations, and VAT and PAYE administration. On the accounting side, Ingwane offers bookkeeping, management accounts, year-end financial statements and tax clearance certificates for its SMME clients. The company also provides digital services, including website design, web hosting and search engine optimisation, giving small businesses a broader set of administrative, financial and online tools under one provider.

Ingwane Company SA operates from 8367 Cashmere Street, Capital View Security Estate, Pretoria, during weekday business hours of 08:00 to 16:00. Its combination of statutory compliance services, accounting support and digital services is aimed at entrepreneurs and SMMEs that need ongoing assistance navigating regulatory requirements while running their businesses.

leg-logistics-transport-eloffsdal.description:
LEG Logistics Transport is a freight forwarding and land transport company based in Eloffsdal, Pretoria, providing logistics and transport services to businesses and organisations that require freight movement. The company is independently listed and classified under freight forwarding and land transport services, operating from 247 Franzina Street, Eloffsdal, Pretoria.

As a freight forwarding provider, LEG Logistics Transport coordinates the movement of goods on behalf of its clients, while its land transport operations support the physical transport component of the logistics chain. This combination positions the company to serve businesses and organisations across Pretoria and the wider region that need reliable freight and transport arrangements as part of their supply chains.

Operating from its Eloffsdal base, LEG Logistics Transport forms part of Pretoria's freight and logistics sector, offering businesses a dedicated transport and freight forwarding service tailored to commercial and organisational shipping needs within the area.

macsteel-trading-pretoria-waltloo.description:
Macsteel Trading - Pretoria is a steel supply branch of the Macsteel Group located at 310 Mundt Street, Waltloo, Pretoria. The branch supplies a full range of structural and general steel products, including angles, beams, channels, columns, expanded metals, flat bars, plates, reinforcing steel, round bars, sheets and tubing, as well as piping and related steel products, to businesses and industry across the Pretoria area.

The Waltloo branch is a newly opened facility, officially launched on 6 July 2026 as a new investment by Macsteel aimed at strengthening the group's presence in the Pretoria market. It serves construction companies, fabricators, engineers, manufacturers, maintenance businesses, merchants and other industrial and commercial customers that require steel and steel-related products for their projects and operations.

In addition to over-the-counter and direct sales from its Waltloo premises, the branch supports online purchasing through Macsteel's online shop, giving customers an additional channel through which to order steel and piping products. As part of the wider Macsteel Group, the Pretoria branch draws on the group's established steel trading operations to offer a broad product range to the construction, fabrication, engineering and manufacturing sectors operating in and around Pretoria.

mdsa-project-management-pty-ltd-bryntiri.description: MDSA Project Management Pty Ltd is a project and construction management consultancy that has operated from its Gauteng head office in Lukasrand, Pretoria, since the company was established in 1998. The firm provides project management, construction management, tenant coordination and client representation services to property developers, owners, investors and businesses undertaking commercial, industrial and retail construction projects. Its portfolio of completed work spans shopping centres, broader commercial developments and industrial projects, reflecting a focus on guiding builds from planning through to completion on behalf of clients who need an experienced representative overseeing contractors, timelines and budgets. Beyond its Pretoria base, MDSA has grown into a multi-regional practice with additional offices in KwaZulu-Natal and in Cape Town and the Cape Winelands, as well as a presence in Mauritius, allowing it to support clients with developments across different parts of South Africa and the wider region. This geographic spread, built up over more than two decades, underpins the firm's experience managing projects for a range of property and construction stakeholders.

molati-attorneys-inc-lynnwood-glen.description: Molati Attorneys Inc is a legal practice serving clients in the greater Pretoria area, offering legal services that include assistance with deceased estates, conveyancing and other property matters, alongside general legal practice work. The firm acts for individuals, families and businesses who require legal representation and advisory support, guiding clients through the administration of estates, property transfers and registrations, and a range of everyday legal matters. Molati Attorneys Inc has been in operation for a number of years and continues to be listed as an active legal practice in current business directories. The firm has relocated from its earlier premises, and clients are advised to confirm its current office location and contact details directly with the practice before visiting, though its core legal services for estates, property and general advisory matters remain available to clients across the Pretoria and wider Tshwane area.

montana-power-tools-moregloed.description: Montana Power Tools is a power-tool sales, repair and machine-workshop business serving the greater Pretoria area. The business sells power tools and provides servicing and repairs for a range of equipment, with its workshop also undertaking precision machining work. Montana Power Tools serves DIY customers, tradespeople, contractors and professional workshops who need tools sourced, serviced or repaired, positioning itself as a point of call for both retail purchases and technical repair work. Its combination of retail sales and an in-house machine workshop allows it to support customers beyond a simple point of sale, handling maintenance and repair needs for tools used in both home and commercial settings. The business is recognised as an accredited service agent for at least one major power-tool brand, reflecting its established repair and servicing capability in the Pretoria market.

nandos-lynnwood-lane-equestria.description: Nando's Lynnwood Lane is a branch of the flame-grilled PERi-PERi chicken chain, located at Shop 111 in the Lynnwood Lane Retail Centre on Lynnwood Road, Equestria, Pretoria. The restaurant serves the brand's Portuguese-inspired menu, including chicken, burgers, wraps, pitas, rice or salad bowls, and a range of sides, as well as larger sharing meals suited to bigger groups. It caters to individuals, families and groups of diners, whether they are eating in, collecting a takeaway order or having food delivered. This branch offers dine-in, collection and delivery options, giving customers flexibility in how they receive their order. Positioned within the Lynnwood Lane Retail Centre, the restaurant serves the surrounding Equestria community and wider Pretoria area with the chain's familiar range of flame-grilled chicken dishes and accompaniments, catering to everyday meals as well as takeaway orders for groups and families.

np-engineering-riviera.description: NP Engineering is a mechanical and electrical engineering company providing engineering solutions, installation, repair and maintenance services to customers across the Pretoria area. The company works with residential, commercial and industrial clients, handling engineering needs that range from installing new mechanical and electrical systems to repairing and maintaining existing equipment and infrastructure. Its services are aimed at keeping clients' systems running reliably, covering both routine maintenance and ad hoc repair work as issues arise. NP Engineering operates beyond Pretoria alone, extending its engineering services throughout Gauteng, Limpopo and Mpumalanga, which allows it to support clients with operations or properties in different parts of these provinces. This regional reach, combined with its focus on mechanical and electrical engineering disciplines, positions the company as a service provider for customers needing ongoing technical support rather than a single once-off installation.

obc-chicken-and-meat-karenpark.description: OBC Chicken and Meat's Karenpark branch is a butchery and fresh-meat retailer located in Karenpark, Akasia. The store sells a wide range of fresh meat products, including chicken, beef, pork, fish and ostrich, with a particular focus on offering customers affordable meat at everyday prices. It serves households and families in the surrounding Akasia area who are looking to do their fresh meat shopping in one place, rather than sourcing different cuts and proteins from multiple stores. OBC is a proudly South African franchise, and this Karenpark branch forms part of that national network, operating under the same brand standards and product range as other OBC outlets. The branch's focus on value-driven pricing across a broad selection of meat types makes it a practical option for customers doing regular household grocery and meat shopping.

octolink-irene.description: OCTOLINK is a facilities-management operation based at Route 21 Corporate Park in Irene, Centurion, offering a comprehensive range of property maintenance and facilities services to businesses, property owners, commercial facilities and other organisations. Its service offering covers painting and waterproofing, roofing, paving, aluminium work, plumbing and electrical work, and the maintenance of roller shutters and automated doors, together with shopfitting, carpentry, drywalling, ceilings, flooring and wallpapering. The company also provides architectural services, space planning and structural-engineering support, giving clients access to both routine maintenance trades and more technical design and engineering input under one service provider. OCTOLINK operates as a partnership between Tollink South Africa (Pty) Ltd and DVY Properties and Maintenance, combining their respective expertise to deliver facilities maintenance, refurbishment and property-management support. Tollink brings more than two decades of experience in maintenance and operations to the partnership and holds ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and ISO 27001 certifications, covering quality management, environmental management, occupational health and safety, and information security respectively. This certification base gives commercial clients added assurance when appointing OCTOLINK for ongoing facilities and property-maintenance work.

ouma-se-nes-waverley.description: Ouma Se Nes is a home-industry bakery trading from Shop 78 in Waverley Plaza on Hertzog Street. The bakery produces a wide range of baked and sweet goods, including cakes, cookies, tarts, pancakes, rusks and biscuits, along with savoury and sweet snacks. It is particularly known for custom birthday cakes and platters made up for parties and other events, and it also stocks children's sweets and candy floss, diabetic-friendly baked products, and small gift items. Ouma Se Nes serves families and individuals who are planning birthdays and other celebrations and need baked goods, cakes or platters prepared for the occasion, as well as everyday customers looking for fresh baked treats. The bakery accepts advance orders so that cakes and platters can be prepared ahead of time and collected when needed. It trades on weekdays from 09:00 to 17:00, on Saturdays from 09:00 to 14:00, and on Sundays from 09:00 to 13:00, giving customers several options across the week to place orders or collect goods.

parrots-centurion.description: Parrots is a casual restaurant located at Centurion Mall on Heuwel Road, offering a broad menu that spans sushi, steaks, pasta, pizza, burgers and ribs, alongside wraps, sandwiches and dedicated breakfast and lunch offerings. This wide-ranging menu allows the restaurant to serve individuals, families and groups of casual diners who may be looking for anything from a quick breakfast or sandwich to a more substantial steak or seafood-style sushi meal in one sitting. Parrots Centurion operates with dine-in seating for guests who want to eat at the restaurant, as well as takeaway and delivery options for customers who prefer to eat elsewhere, and it accepts reservations for diners who want to book a table in advance. Set within Centurion Mall, the restaurant is positioned to serve both mall shoppers looking for a sit-down meal and customers from the wider area ordering in for takeaway or delivery.

pna-zambezi-montana-park.description: PNA Zambezi is a branch of the PNA stationery, books, arts and crafts, and educational-products retail chain, trading from Shop 12 in Zambesi Junction on Tibouchina Street, Montana Park. The store stocks a range spanning stationery supplies, books, arts and crafts materials, and educational products, serving students, parents, schools, teachers, artists, crafters and general retail customers from the surrounding Montana Park area. As part of the established PNA chain, the branch draws on the group's broad product offering, giving local shoppers access to school and office stationery alongside craft supplies and reading material in one store. PNA Zambezi trades seven days a week, open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 18:00, Saturday from 08:00 to 18:00, and Sunday from 08:00 to 16:00, giving customers wide access across the week whether they are stocking up for school terms, sourcing craft materials for a project, or picking up books and stationery items. Its location within Zambesi Junction places it conveniently for shoppers already visiting the centre, making it a practical stop for stationery, educational and creative supplies needs in the Montana Park area.

rain-store-queenswood-queenswood.description: rain Store - Queenswood is a retail outlet for rain, the mobile and fixed-wireless connectivity provider, trading from Queenswood Quarter at the corner of Stead and Whittle in Queenswood. The store offers rain's mobile and fixed-wireless connectivity products, including 5G mobile services, home WiFi and mobile WiFi packages, serving households and individuals in the Queenswood area who need mobile or fixed-wireless internet connectivity. Customers can visit the store to explore rain's range of connectivity options and sign up for services suited to their home or personal internet needs. As a current tenant of Queenswood Quarter, the store is positioned within an established retail centre, making it accessible to shoppers already in the area as well as those specifically seeking out connectivity solutions. The branch forms part of rain's retail footprint in the greater Pretoria area, extending the provider's mobile and home internet offerings to residents and individuals in and around Queenswood who are looking for alternatives to traditional fixed-line internet services.

sterns-wonderpark-karenpark.description: Sterns - Wonderpark is a branch of the Sterns jewellery retail chain, trading from Shop 101A in Wonderpark Shopping Centre at the corner of Brits Road and Heinrich Avenue, Karenpark. The store offers a range of contemporary and classic jewellery, including bridal jewellery for engagements and weddings, as well as gift jewellery suited to a variety of occasions. It serves individuals and couples shopping for jewellery, whether selecting engagement or wedding rings, or browsing for a gift for a special occasion. As part of the established Sterns chain, the branch draws on the group's broader jewellery range and retail experience, giving shoppers in the Karenpark area access to a mix of traditional and modern jewellery styles under one roof. Sterns - Wonderpark trades Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 19:00, Saturday from 09:00 to 17:00, and Sunday from 09:00 to 15:00, giving customers extended hours across the week to shop for jewellery. Positioned within Wonderpark Shopping Centre, the store is well placed to serve both mall shoppers and customers specifically visiting for bridal or gift jewellery purchases.

superway-construction-pty-ltd-equestria.description: Superway Construction (Pty) Ltd is a construction company based in the Willow Glen area of Pretoria, established in 1988. The company operates across the building, civil and road construction industries, providing construction services to government, commercial and industrial clients as well as property developers involved in infrastructure projects. Superway Construction is a member of SAFCEC, the South African Forum of Civil Engineering Contractors, and is registered with the CIDB, the Construction Industry Development Board, holding registrations in the 9GB (general building), 9CE (civil engineering), 6EB (electrical) and 5ME (mechanical) contractor categories. This combination of industry membership and multi-category CIDB registration reflects a company equipped to handle a range of construction work, from general building projects to civil engineering and road construction, as well as electrical and mechanical scopes within larger contracts. With more than three decades in operation, Superway Construction has built up experience serving clients who need an established, accredited contractor for building, civil and road infrastructure projects in and around Pretoria, drawing on its long-standing industry registrations as evidence of its compliance and capability in the construction sector.

the-courier-guy-engen-raslouw-locker-ras.description: The Courier Guy Engen Raslouw Locker is a self-service parcel locker point operated by The Courier Guy, located at the main entrance of the Engen service station on Lochner Road, Swartkop, Centurion. The locker allows individuals and businesses to send and receive courier parcels without needing to visit a staffed branch, offering a convenient drop-off and collection point for customers in the Raslouw and surrounding Centurion area. Positioned at a filling station entrance, the locker is easily accessible to motorists and local residents who are already passing through the area, making it a practical option for parcel collection or drop-off alongside a fuel stop or other errands. As part of The Courier Guy's broader network of locker points, this location extends the courier company's self-service parcel infrastructure into the Centurion area, giving customers an alternative to in-person counter service for sending and receiving deliveries. The locker is categorised under logistics, courier and transport services, reflecting its role within The Courier Guy's parcel delivery network.

the-courier-guy-postlink-lyttelton-point.description: The Courier Guy Postlink Lyttelton Point is a parcel collection and drop-off point operated by The Courier Guy from a Postlink location at 99 Cantonments Road, Lyttelton Manor, Centurion. The point allows individuals and businesses to send and receive courier parcels at a location within the Lyttelton Manor area, offering an alternative to a full-service branch for customers who need to drop off or collect deliveries. Operating from a Postlink site, the point forms part of The Courier Guy's network of collection points that extend its courier services into local neighbourhoods, making parcel handling more accessible to residents and businesses in Lyttelton Manor and the surrounding Centurion area. The location is categorised under logistics, courier and transport services, reflecting its function within The Courier Guy's broader parcel delivery and collection network. For customers in the area who need to send a parcel or collect a delivery without travelling to a larger branch, this Postlink point offers a local option within easy reach of the Lyttelton Manor community.

the-courier-guy-vinstra-centre-valhalla-.description: The Courier Guy Vinstra Centre Valhalla Locker is a self-service parcel locker point operated by The Courier Guy, situated by the main entrance of the shop on Vinstra Road, Valhalla, Centurion. The locker provides individuals and businesses in the Valhalla area with a self-service option for sending and receiving courier parcels, allowing customers to drop off or collect deliveries without needing to visit a staffed branch counter. Positioned at the entrance of a local shop, the locker is readily accessible to shoppers and residents passing through the area, making it a convenient stop for parcel collection or drop-off alongside other errands. As part of The Courier Guy's wider network of self-service locker points, this location extends the courier company's parcel infrastructure into the Valhalla area, giving customers in and around Centurion an additional way to manage deliveries outside of standard branch hours or locations. The locker is categorised under logistics, courier and transport services, reflecting its role in The Courier Guy's parcel delivery network.

totalenergies-centurion-gate-zwartkop.description: TotalEnergies Centurion Gate is a fuel station located on John Vorster Drive in Centurion Gate, Centurion, supplying petrol and diesel to private motorists, commuters, commercial drivers and local businesses in the area. The station operates 24 hours a day, giving customers round-the-clock access to refuelling regardless of the time of day or night. Beyond fuel, the station offers a range of associated services, including car washing facilities, café and convenience retail offerings, and vehicle maintenance and repair services, allowing customers to combine a fuel stop with other vehicle-related needs in a single visit. This combination of round-the-clock refuelling, convenience retail and vehicle servicing makes the station a practical stop for commuters travelling through Centurion Gate as well as commercial drivers and local businesses needing reliable, accessible fuel supply at any hour. Its position on John Vorster Drive places it along a well-used route through Centurion, serving both through-traffic and the surrounding local community with its fuel, convenience and vehicle-care offerings.

tribeca-standard-lynnwood-manor.description: Tribeca Standard is a café and restaurant trading from Shop 25 in Lynnwood Bridge Shopping Centre, at the corner of Daventry Street and Lynnwood Road, Lynnwood Manor. The venue serves coffee alongside a café-style menu that includes burgers and other light meals, catering to breakfast, lunch, dinner and takeaway orders throughout the day. It serves coffee customers, individuals, families, groups and professionals looking for a casual dining spot, whether for a quick breakfast, a working lunch, a relaxed dinner or a takeaway order. As part of the TriBeCa restaurant brand's STANDARD format, the Lynnwood Bridge venue has operated at this location since at least 2010, giving it a long-standing presence within the shopping centre. Its position within Lynnwood Bridge Shopping Centre makes it accessible to shoppers, office workers and residents in the surrounding Lynnwood Manor area, serving as a regular spot for coffee and café fare across different times of day, from morning breakfasts through to evening meals and takeaway orders.

tulip-management-accounting-services-ras.description: Tulip Management Accounting Services is a management-accounting and taxation support business located at No. 2, 67 Baard Avenue in Leanka Estate, Raslouw, Centurion. Founded in 2005, the business provides management of accounting functions along with assistance with taxation requirements, serving growing businesses and established organisations that need ongoing support with their accounting and tax-related obligations. Its services are aimed at clients who require more than once-off bookkeeping, offering continuity in managing the accounting function and supporting taxation compliance as a business grows or as its organisational needs evolve. Operating from Leanka Estate in Raslouw, the business serves clients across the Centurion and wider Pretoria area, drawing on more than two decades of experience since its founding to support organisations with the ongoing administrative and compliance demands of managing accounts and taxation requirements. This established track record positions Tulip Management Accounting Services as a long-standing resource for businesses in the area seeking dependable support with management accounting and tax-related matters rather than a once-off service.

freddy-hirsch-group-pty-ltd-pretoria-elo.description: Freddy Hirsch Group (Pty) Ltd is an established South African food-ingredient manufacturer and supplier that has operated for more than 60 years, with its head office in Johannesburg and branches across South Africa. The company develops and supplies seasonings, marinades, sauces, functional ingredients and other food-technology solutions used by businesses in the food-processing and food-service industries. Its product range is formulated to support manufacturers and food-service operators in developing flavour profiles, extending shelf life and meeting processing requirements across a variety of meat, poultry and other food applications. Operating both within South Africa and internationally, Freddy Hirsch Group has built a long-standing reputation as a reliable ingredient partner to the food industry, combining technical formulation expertise with a broad distribution footprint. The group's South African branch network, which includes a presence in Pretoria, gives local food producers and food-service businesses access to its established ingredient range and technical support.

gc-solar-head-office-brooklands-lifestyl.description: GC Solar is an established South African solar energy company that supplies complete solar systems and energy-storage solutions, including solar panels, inverters and batteries, to residential, commercial and industrial customers. The company serves customers seeking solar power generation, backup electricity during outages, and broader renewable energy solutions, offering the equipment needed to move a property onto solar power or add storage capacity to an existing system. GC Solar's offering spans the specification, supply and support of solar installations for homes, businesses and industrial sites, catering to customers who want to reduce reliance on the grid, secure backup power during load shedding or outages, or lower long-term energy costs through renewable generation. As a supplier operating within South Africa's growing solar and energy-storage sector, GC Solar positions its systems to meet the needs of both new solar installations and upgrades to existing setups, with a focus on combining panels, inverters and battery storage into complete, functional energy solutions for its customers.

v4-creative-erasmuskloof.description: V4 Creative is a Pretoria-based web design and digital branding agency, founded in 2014, serving small and medium enterprises looking to establish, improve or maintain an online presence. The agency's services span web design and web development, user experience and interface (UX/UI) design, graphic design and branding, and e-commerce website builds, together with hosting and ongoing website maintenance. It also offers digital marketing support including search engine optimisation (SEO) and social media marketing, helping clients manage and grow their presence across online channels. V4 Creative acts as a digital partner for businesses that need a professional website alongside the marketing tools to attract and retain customers, combining design and technical development with longer-term digital strategy. Its work covers everything from initial brand identity and website design through to continued technical upkeep and online marketing campaigns, making it suited to SMEs that want a single provider managing both the creative and technical sides of their digital footprint. The agency continues to operate from the greater Pretoria area, serving local businesses as well as clients further afield who need an established web and marketing partner for day-to-day digital needs.

vision-print-booysens.description: Vision Print is a commercial printing and copy shop based on Bremer Street in Claremont, Pretoria, confirmed as currently operating from this address. The business serves businesses, organisations and individuals who need printing and copying services, offering full-colour lithographic printing alongside business cards, letterheads, brochures and posters. Vision Print also provides design support, binding, die-cutting and rubber stamp production, giving customers a shop for both the creative and finishing side of print jobs. As a dedicated commercial printer, it caters to local businesses needing marketing collateral and corporate stationery as well as individuals requiring smaller print and copy runs. Operating from its Claremont premises in Pretoria 0082, Vision Print continues to serve the surrounding business community with day-to-day copying needs and larger commercial print orders, maintaining its position as an established, locally based print and copy shop in the area.

voltra-energy-solutions-florauna.description: VOLTRA ENERGY SOLUTIONS (PTY) LTD is a solar and alternative-energy company based in Florauna, Pretoria, supplying and installing complete solar power solutions for homeowners and businesses. Its services cover the full process of adopting solar energy, from initial consultation and on-site assessments through to the supply and installation of solar equipment, followed by after-care and ongoing maintenance support. VOLTRA positions itself as a full-service provider for customers seeking energy independence, guiding clients from the planning stage of a solar installation through to long-term upkeep of the system. The company serves clients not only in Pretoria but across Gauteng, North West and surrounding areas, reflecting a regional footprint beyond its Florauna base. By combining site-specific assessments with installation and after-sales maintenance, VOLTRA aims to deliver solar systems suited to each customer's power needs, whether for residential backup power or larger commercial energy requirements. Its continued operation from Florauna, Pretoria, and its documented service offering confirm it remains an active supplier of solar installation and maintenance services in the region.

walquin-precision-engineering-pty-ltd-ee.description: Walquin Precision Engineering (Pty) Ltd is a precision engineering business operating from Shop 43 at the corner of Asetileen and Conveyor Street in Silvertondale, Eersterust, Pretoria. The company provides technical manufacturing and engineering services to industrial and commercial customers, and is categorised under architectural and engineering activities and technical consultancy. Its work centres on precision engineering output for businesses requiring accurately manufactured components and technical engineering input, positioning it as a specialist supplier within Pretoria's industrial manufacturing sector. Current records confirm the company still trades from its Silvertondale, Eersterust premises, consistent with its established location, and continues to serve the industrial and commercial client base that relies on precision-engineered parts and technical consultancy support. By operating from a dedicated industrial address in Eersterust, Walquin Precision Engineering remains positioned to serve manufacturing, engineering and related commercial customers across the greater Pretoria area who need reliable, precision-manufactured components and associated technical engineering services.

wonders-hair-studio-wonderboom.description: Wonder's Hair Studio is a hair salon located at 110 Blinkblaar Avenue in Wonderboom, Pretoria, serving women, men and children seeking a wide range of hair styling and treatment services. The salon's offering includes balayage and colouring, highlights, blow-drying, braiding, hair extensions and weaves, as well as chemical treatments such as keratin smoothing, perms and permanent straightening. It also caters specifically to younger clients with dedicated children's haircuts, making it a family-friendly option within the Wonderboom area. Current listings confirm the salon continues to operate from its Blinkblaar Avenue address, offering the same broad service portfolio spanning everyday cuts and blow-dries through to more involved colour and chemical treatments. Clients visiting Wonder's Hair Studio can combine services such as colouring with extensions or straightening in a single visit, supporting customers who want both routine maintenance and more significant style changes. The studio's continued presence in Wonderboom, Pretoria 0182, and its documented range of services confirm it remains an active, full-service hair salon catering to the local community.

adek-wapadrand.description: Adek is a long-established estate agency, property developer and auctioneer serving the Wapadrand and greater Pretoria East area. The business was founded in Sandton in 1972, giving it more than 45 years of operating history in the South African property market. Adek's services span residential, commercial and agricultural property sales, property development, investment property, and property auctions, serving buyers, sellers, investors and developers across these categories. Its operating areas explicitly include Wapadrand, Pretoria East, Pretoria and the surrounding suburbs, reflecting a long-standing focus on this part of the city alongside its broader footprint. As both an estate agency and a property developer, Adek is positioned to assist clients beyond straightforward residential sales, extending into commercial and agricultural property transactions as well as auction sales for property disposals. Its decades of continuous operation since 1972 give it an established track record in the Pretoria property market, serving a wide range of client needs from individual home buyers and sellers to investors and developers seeking agricultural or commercial opportunities in and around Wapadrand and Pretoria East.

afrisolar-supplies-magalieskruin.description: AfriSolar Supplies is a solar energy company based at 321 Braam Pretorius Street in Magalieskruin, Pretoria, supplying and installing solar solutions for homeowners and businesses. Its product range covers solar panels, inverters and batteries, supported by professional installation carried out by the company's own team. Before installation, AfriSolar Supplies conducts site assessments to determine the most suitable system for each property, and it continues to offer after-sales support once a system has been installed. This combination of supply, installation, assessment and ongoing support makes it a suited option for customers wanting backup power, off-grid capability or a broader move toward renewable energy. The company serves both residential customers looking for power backup and businesses seeking a more permanent renewable energy solution, tailoring system size and components to the site assessment carried out beforehand. Operating from its confirmed Magalieskruin premises, AfriSolar Supplies remains an active local supplier within Pretoria's solar energy sector, taking customers from initial site evaluation through to installed systems and continued after-sales assistance.

annelie-grundlingh-attorneys-garsfontein.description: Annelie Grundlingh Attorneys is a specialist labour-law practice operating from Units 19 and 20 at Garsfontein Office Park, 645 Jacqueline Drive, Garsfontein, Pretoria. The firm focuses specifically on labour and employment law, advising and representing employees, employers, companies and organisations on labour-law matters, including litigation before relevant courts and tribunals. Described as a small Pretoria-based practice, the firm travels nationally to represent clients, extending its reach beyond the greater Pretoria area to labour-law matters elsewhere in South Africa. Its continued activity is confirmed by a February 2025 High Court judgment that records the firm as attorneys of record, demonstrating it remains an active litigation practice. By concentrating specifically on labour law rather than general legal practice, Annelie Grundlingh Attorneys offers clients focused expertise in employment disputes, workplace litigation and related advisory work. The firm's base at Garsfontein Office Park provides an established Pretoria address from which it continues to serve both individual employees and organisational clients needing experienced representation in labour and employment-law matters, whether through advice, negotiation or court litigation.

annette-eales-wapadrand-agent-of-choice-.description: Annette Eales is a qualified property practitioner working with Chas Everitt, covering Wapadrand and the broader Pretoria area. As a Chas Everitt agent, she assists clients with buying and selling both residential and commercial property, handling negotiations between buyers and sellers throughout the transaction process. Her current property listings extend beyond Wapadrand to include Waterkloof Ridge, Mooikloof Equestrian Estate, Equestria and other Pretoria suburbs, reflecting an active presence across several areas of Pretoria and its surrounds rather than Wapadrand alone. Operating under the Chas Everitt brand gives clients access to an established national estate agency network while working with a locally focused practitioner who knows the Wapadrand and wider Pretoria property market. Her services cover the full range of residential and commercial property transactions, from initial listing and marketing through to negotiating offers and guiding buyers and sellers to a completed sale. For home buyers, sellers, investors and property owners in Pretoria and the surrounding suburbs, Annette Eales offers an established, currently active point of contact within the Chas Everitt agency for navigating property sales in the area.

artbox-framing-elardus-park.description: ArtBox Framing is a professional custom picture-framing studio based in Pretoria, serving artists, collectors, households and businesses who need framing for artwork, posters, certificates, diplomas and memorabilia. The studio offers both traditional and modern framing styles, with mounting and presentation work tailored to the item being framed, from fine art pieces to official documents and personal keepsakes. Frames are custom-made by hand on the premises by a master framer, giving customers bespoke framing rather than standardised, off-the-shelf options. Alongside its framing work, ArtBox Framing operates as an art gallery, displaying pieces for sale, and also houses a jewellery studio on-site, broadening its offering beyond framing alone. This combination of custom framing, gallery space and jewellery studio makes it a multi-purpose destination for clients with varied creative and presentation needs, whether they are preserving a certificate or diploma, mounting artwork for display, or browsing gallery pieces and jewellery. ArtBox Framing's hand-crafted approach, carried out by a master framer on-site, sets it apart from generic framing outlets in the Pretoria area.

bakgoni-electrical-and-special-projects-.description: Bakgoni Electrical And Special Projects is an electrical contracting business operating in the Pretoria area, recognised as a member of the Electrical Contractors' Association of South Africa (ECA(SA)). The company carries out electrical installation and wiring work, including distribution board work, for residential, commercial and institutional customers. It also undertakes solar installation work, reflecting a broader focus on both conventional electrical wiring and renewable energy connections. As an ECA(SA) member, Bakgoni Electrical And Special Projects operates within the recognised compliance framework for electrical contractors in South Africa, offering clients electrical-compliance-related services alongside standard installation work. Its customer base spans residential properties, commercial premises and institutional clients, indicating a contracting operation capable of handling projects across different property types and scales. By combining core electrical wiring and installation work with solar installation services, the business serves customers who need both everyday electrical work and renewable-energy-related electrical connections. Its recognised ECA(SA) membership offers industry-standard assurance for customers in the greater Pretoria area seeking a registered electrical contractor for wiring, distribution-board and solar installation work.

bb-aerial-surveyors-murrayfield.description: BB Aerial Surveyors is a LiDAR aerial surveying and mapping company headquartered at 92 Rubida Street in Murrayfield, Pretoria. The company captures high-resolution aerial and geospatial data used for infrastructure projects, power corridors, mining operations, environmental assessments and broader development planning. Its surveying work serves engineering firms, infrastructure developers, mining companies, environmental consultancies, energy providers and other development-focused organisations that need accurate aerial data to support planning and project execution. From its Pretoria base, BB Aerial Surveyors extends its services throughout South Africa and into the wider African continent, reflecting a surveying operation built to support large-scale, geographically dispersed projects rather than purely local work. By specialising in LiDAR technology specifically, the company offers clients a level of mapping precision suited to complex infrastructure and environmental projects where accurate elevation and geospatial detail are essential. Its continued operation from the Murrayfield address and ongoing work across sectors including mining, power and infrastructure confirm BB Aerial Surveyors remains an active, specialised aerial survey provider serving both the Pretoria region and clients further afield across Africa.

berkit-manufacturing-waltloo.description: Berkit Manufacturing is an electrical and mechanical manufacturing company based at Unit 21-24, Anglo Industrial Park, accessed via the Kuit Street entrance at 319 Waltoo Road in Waltloo, Pretoria. The company specialises in wire processing and broader industrial manufacturing solutions, serving industrial and commercial customers who need manufactured electrical and mechanical components or assemblies. Its technical team covers the full range of customer requirements across electrical and mechanical engineering, combining sales and research and development with logistics and production capacity. Beyond manufacturing itself, Berkit Manufacturing provides technical design input and field support, allowing it to assist customers from the initial design stage of a project through to production and on-site support once components are supplied. This end-to-end structure, spanning research and development, production, design and field support, positions the company as a manufacturing partner rather than a simple parts supplier for industrial and commercial clients. Operating from its confirmed Waltloo premises, Berkit Manufacturing continues to serve customers across Pretoria's industrial sector who require wire processing and broader electrical or mechanical manufacturing solutions, backed by in-house technical design and support capability.

beyond-bowling-eco-park.description: Beyond Bowling is a ten-pin bowling and entertainment venue located at Shop 27, Eco Boulevard Shopping Centre, Witch-Hazel Avenue, in Eco Park, Centurion. The venue features 10 traditional free-fall bowling lanes, able to accommodate around 80 to 100 players at a time, making it suited to both small groups and larger gatherings. Beyond the bowling lanes, the venue offers pool tables, arcade games and table tennis, alongside a sports bar serving food and drinks, giving visitors a range of activities to combine with their bowling session. Beyond Bowling regularly hosts karaoke nights and quiz nights, as well as live events, positioning it as an entertainment destination beyond a standard bowling alley. It serves a broad customer base including families and children, groups of friends, corporate teams and parties, and also hosts corporate and team-building events for businesses. This combination of bowling, arcade entertainment, food and drink, and scheduled events such as quiz and karaoke nights makes Beyond Bowling a multi-purpose venue within Eco Park, Centurion, suited to everything from casual family outings to organised corporate functions and recurring social nights out.

blue-knight-estates-rietondale.description: Blue Knight Estates is a boutique real-estate agency that has served Pretoria Moot and the surrounding areas since 2004. The agency focuses on residential property sales and rentals, offering specialised services designed to help property owners and investors maximise the returns on their properties. Rather than operating as a large, generalist agency, Blue Knight Estates positions itself around close, ongoing relationships between landlords and tenants, aiming to manage this relationship carefully throughout a lease or sale. Its client base includes property owners looking to sell or let their homes, investors seeking rental returns, as well as buyers and tenants searching for suitable properties in the area. With two decades of operation in the Pretoria Moot region, the agency has built up local market knowledge of residential property sales and rentals, and continues to offer tailored support throughout the sales and letting process to both property owners and the tenants who occupy their properties.

build-it-montana-montana-park.description: Build it Montana is a hardware and building-materials retailer located at the corner of Dr Swanepoel Road and Sefako Makgatho Drive in Montana Crossings, Montana, Pretoria. The store forms part of the nationwide Build It group of independently owned hardware retailers, and stocks a broad range of building materials alongside hardware, tools, plumbing and electrical supplies, paint, and garden and DIY products. It serves homeowners undertaking their own home-improvement projects as well as builders, contractors and other tradespeople sourcing construction materials and equipment for larger jobs.
