As a Build It branch, the store caters to both walk-in DIY customers looking for everyday hardware items and trade customers requiring bulk building supplies. Its Montana location places it within reach of residents and construction businesses operating in the northern parts of Pretoria, offering a one-stop source for building, renovation and general household maintenance needs.

c-v-repair-services-koedoespoort.description: C.V. Repair Services is a Villieria-based automotive workshop specialising in the repair of CV joints and suspension parts, a focus the business has maintained since 1992. Operating from 440 33rd Avenue in Villieria, Pretoria, the workshop serves private vehicle owners, motorists and other workshops that need specialist attention to these vehicle components rather than general mechanical work. CV joints and suspension parts are subject to significant wear over a vehicle's lifetime, and C.V. Repair Services has built its service offering specifically around diagnosing and repairing faults in this part of a vehicle's drivetrain and suspension system. Its long-standing specialisation means customers can bring vehicles in for targeted suspension and CV-joint related repairs rather than relying on a general repair shop. The business continues to operate from its Villieria premises, serving motorists from the surrounding Pretoria area who require this specific type of automotive repair work.

cash-crusaders-elardus-park-elardus-park.description: Cash Crusaders Elardus Park is a retail store trading from Shop 0007 in The Park Shopping Centre, on the corner of Delmas Road and Barnard Street in Elardus Park, Pretoria. The store buys and sells a wide range of new and pre-owned goods, giving shoppers access to second-hand electronics, appliances and other consumer items at reduced prices, while also providing a convenient outlet for customers wanting to sell goods they no longer need. In addition to its retail trade, the branch offers cash-loan services, allowing customers to borrow against qualifying valuables for a 30-day period. The store caters to a broad range of customers, including those looking to buy affordable second-hand goods, individuals wanting to sell items, and customers in need of short-term cash loans secured against their belongings. The branch also accepts collections of goods that customers wish to sell, making it a practical option for residents of Elardus Park and the surrounding area looking to buy, sell or borrow against household and electronic items.

century-21-pretoria-east-wapadrand.description: Century 21 Pretoria East is a branch of the Century 21 real-estate franchise network, operating from Stonehill Office Park at the corner of Solomon Mahlangu and Disselboom Avenue in Wapadrand, Pretoria. As part of the broader Century 21 brand, the office provides residential property sales and related real-estate services to clients across Pretoria East. It serves property buyers and sellers looking to transact on homes in the area, as well as landlords, tenants and investors seeking rental or investment opportunities. Operating under the established Century 21 franchise system gives the Wapadrand office access to the group's broader property networks and listing resources while focusing its day-to-day service on the Pretoria East residential market. Clients working with the branch can expect support throughout the process of buying, selling or letting residential property, with the office acting as a local point of contact for the Century 21 brand in the Wapadrand and surrounding Pretoria East area.

checkers-grey-owl-midstream-louwlardia.description: Checkers Grey Owl Midstream is a full-service supermarket located at 1869 Brakfontein Road in Louwlardia Extension 10, Centurion, serving households, families and commuters across the Midstream and Louwlardia area. The store stocks groceries, fresh produce, meat and household essentials, and includes a bakery, a delicatessen, a dedicated Meat Market and a Cheese World section, along with a Wine Route offering for customers seeking a wider selection of wines. Shoppers can also make use of a Foreign Ground Café for coffee and light meals, a Money Market counter for bill payments and related financial services, and an on-site restaurant for sit-down meals. Additional convenience services at the branch include a car wash, a key-cutting service and ATMs. The store also offers Sixty60 on-demand delivery, allowing customers in the surrounding Centurion suburbs to have groceries delivered rather than shopping in person. Together, these services position the Grey Owl Midstream branch as a one-stop shopping destination for everyday grocery needs as well as food, drink and convenience services for the local community.

checkers-olympus-village-olympus.description: Checkers Olympus Village is a supermarket situated within the Olympus Village Shopping Centre, on the corner of Olympus Drive and Achilles Road in Olympus, Pretoria East. The store serves as an anchor tenant of the centre, which opened on 17 March 2016 and houses around 30 stores in total. Checkers Olympus Village stocks groceries, fresh produce, bakery and deli items, and prepared foods alongside everyday household essentials, serving households and families living in the Olympus and broader Pretoria East area. As the anchor supermarket of a shopping centre that opened relatively recently, the store forms a central part of the centre's retail offering, drawing shoppers who also make use of the other stores within Olympus Village. Its position within an established, multi-store shopping centre makes it a convenient grocery destination for residents in the surrounding Pretoria East suburbs, who can combine their weekly grocery shop with visits to the centre's other retailers.

checkers-pretoria-north-heatherview.description: Checkers Pretoria North is a supermarket located within the North Park Shopping Centre, on the corner of Emily Hobhouse and Gerrit Maritz Road in Pretoria North. The store supplies groceries, fresh produce, meat and household products to households, families and commuters in the surrounding Pretoria North area, and includes a bakery, a delicatessen and a fish counter alongside prepared foods for shoppers looking for ready-to-eat options. Additional in-store sections include a dedicated Meat Market and a Cheese World counter, giving customers a wider selection of fresh meat and cheese than a standard grocery aisle. A Foreign Ground Café offers coffee and light refreshments, while a Money Market counter provides bill payments and related services. The branch also offers a key-cutting service and supports Sixty60 on-demand grocery delivery, allowing customers nearby to have their shopping delivered rather than visiting the store in person. Together, these services make the North Park branch a comprehensive grocery and convenience destination for residents of Pretoria North.

checkers-silver-lakes-hazeldean.description: Checkers Silver Lakes is a supermarket located in the Chamberlain Shopping Centre, also known as Six Fountains, on the corner of Solomon Mahlangu Drive and Bendeman Boulevard in Silver Lakes, Pretoria East. The store serves households and families in the Silver Lakes area, stocking groceries, fresh produce, meat, bakery and deli items and household goods. Shoppers can also make use of a salad bar and a selection of prepared foods for quick, ready-to-eat meals, as well as a range of organic products for customers seeking healthier or specialty grocery options. The branch supports same-day delivery and in-store pickup, giving customers the choice of shopping in person or having groceries collected or delivered. Positioned within the Chamberlain Shopping Centre, the store forms part of a broader retail node serving the Silver Lakes and surrounding Pretoria East residential community, offering a full range of everyday grocery needs alongside its more specialised food counters and delivery options.

checkers-waverley-waverley.description: Checkers Waverley is a supermarket located on the corner of Codonia and Cunningham Avenue in Waverley, Pretoria, serving households and families in Waverley and the surrounding northern Pretoria suburbs. The store stocks groceries, household essentials and fresh produce, with a bakery, a delicatessen and a fresh fish counter supplementing the grocery range, as well as prepared foods for customers looking for convenient meal options. The branch offers both delivery and in-store pickup, giving shoppers flexibility in how they do their grocery shopping, and supports contactless and NFC card payments at checkout for faster transactions. As a neighbourhood supermarket in Waverley, the store caters primarily to local residents doing regular grocery shopping, while its combination of fresh counters, prepared foods and modern payment and delivery options positions it as a convenient, full-service option for the surrounding community.

chips-away-centurion.description: Chips Away Centurion is an automotive body-repair business operating from Centurion Auto City at 1030 Lenchen Avenue in Centurion. The business specialises in cosmetic vehicle repairs, carrying out paintwork and repairs to minor accident and body damage rather than major structural or mechanical work. It serves private vehicle owners and motorists seeking to have scratches, dents, chips and other surface damage repaired, as well as dealerships and insurers that require cosmetic repair work done on vehicles before resale or as part of a claims process. Operating from within the Centurion Auto City precinct, a hub of motor-related businesses, Chips Away Centurion is positioned to serve customers from across Centurion looking for a focused cosmetic repair service rather than a full panel-beating operation. Its location on Lenchen Avenue places it within easy reach of residents and businesses throughout the Centurion area who need vehicle paintwork and minor body-damage repairs attended to.

ck-tree-felling-parktown-estate.description: CK Tree Felling provides professional tree-felling and arboricultural services from Merwede Street in Mountain View, Pretoria. The business is run by certified arborists who focus on the safe and precise removal of dead, diseased, dangerous or otherwise unwanted trees, along with related services such as stump grinding, pruning and garden rubble removal. It serves homeowners, property managers, businesses and other property owners who need trees removed or maintained safely, without risk to surrounding structures or people. In addition to its Mountain View base, CK Tree Felling extends its services to surrounding suburbs including Kameeldrift West, Akasia, Rosslyn and Montana, giving it a reach across the northern parts of Pretoria. By combining certified arborist expertise with a focus on safety and precision, the business positions itself as a specialist option for tree removal and management work, rather than general landscaping, for customers who need potentially hazardous trees dealt with correctly.

ck-waverley-house-cleaning-carpet-cleani.description: CK Waverley House Cleaning & Carpet Cleaning operates from 765 Codonia Avenue in Waverley, Pretoria, offering house-cleaning and carpet-cleaning services to residential customers, alongside commercial cleaning for business premises. The company is listed under carpet cleaning, commercial cleaning and house cleaning categories, reflecting a service range that covers regular household cleaning as well as deeper carpet-cleaning work, in addition to cleaning contracts for commercial clients. Households in Waverley and the surrounding Pretoria area can use the business for routine home cleaning or for specific carpet-cleaning jobs, while businesses in the area can engage the company for ongoing commercial cleaning needs. Operating from a fixed Waverley address gives the business an established local base from which to serve both private homes and commercial premises in the surrounding suburbs, offering a combined cleaning service that spans general household upkeep and more specialised carpet care.

crisp-fibre-pty-ltd-kloofsig.description: Crisp Fibre (Pty) Ltd is a licensed Fibre Network Operator and Internet Service Provider based at 78 Kalkoen Street in Monument Park, Pretoria. Founded in 2018, the company provides fibre connectivity and broader internet solutions, working closely with property developers and estate managers to roll out fibre infrastructure to new and existing residential estates, as well as serving residential users, businesses and other end users directly. As a licensed FNO and ISP, Crisp Fibre is able to both build and operate fibre network infrastructure and supply internet connectivity over that network, giving it a role across the full chain from infrastructure development to end-user service delivery. The company operates across South Africa and the wider southern African region, with a team of between 11 and 50 employees supporting its network operations and customer base. Its focus on partnering with developers and estate managers positions Crisp Fibre as a specialist in bringing fibre connectivity to planned residential developments, in addition to its work with established businesses and residential customers in the Monument Park area and beyond.

cross-fit-radium-centurion.description: CrossFit Radium is a CrossFit affiliate gym located at 2221 Hendrik Verwoerd Drive South in Centurion, operated under Enduro Fitness (Pty) Ltd, which also holds the CrossFit Curium affiliation. The gym has been a registered CrossFit affiliate for 13 years, offering coached CrossFit and fitness training through structured daily class programming. Its extensive class schedule caters to adults and fitness enthusiasts across a wide range of abilities, from beginners new to CrossFit through to experienced athletes with established strength and conditioning backgrounds. Coaches run group sessions throughout the day, allowing members to work toward goals ranging from general fitness and conditioning to more focused strength and performance training. As a long-standing affiliate within the global CrossFit network, CrossFit Radium follows the structured, varied programming associated with the CrossFit methodology, while its Centurion location and Enduro Fitness ownership give it a stable, established presence for members training regularly in the area.

cycle-lab-lynnwood-megastore-lynnwood-ri.description: Cycle Lab Lynnwood Megastore is a large cycling retailer based at Lynnridge Mall, No. 1 Jacobson Drive, in Lynnwood, Pretoria. Described as a premier cycling superstore, it stocks bicycles, cycling accessories, clothing and equipment spanning multiple cycling disciplines, catering to road cyclists, mountain bikers and recreational riders alike. The store serves both beginner and experienced cyclists, offering a range of bikes and gear suited to different skill levels and riding styles. Alongside its retail floor, the Lynnwood Megastore houses a state-of-the-art, on-site professional bicycle workshop, where customers can have their bicycles serviced and repaired by trained technicians. This combination of a large retail selection and an in-house workshop allows the store to support cyclists throughout their ownership of a bicycle, from initial purchase of a bike, apparel and accessories through to ongoing maintenance and repair work. Its Lynnwood Ridge location makes it a prominent cycling destination for riders across Pretoria East looking for a comprehensive range of cycling products and professional servicing in one location.

danice-waste-management-grootfontein-cou.description: Danice Waste Management operates from 89 Tanya Street in Grootfontein Country Estates, providing waste-management services to both residential and commercial customers. Its core services include general refuse removal, skip-bin rental, recycling collection, and the management of garden and organic waste, alongside other specialised waste-removal services. The company also runs on-site recycling and waste-management operations as part of its broader service offering. Beyond simply removing waste, Danice Waste Management positions its work around the goal of responsible waste disposal, aiming to manage refuse and recyclable materials in an environmentally considered way, while also contributing toward job creation through its operations. Residential customers can use the company for regular household refuse removal or for renting skip bins during larger clean-ups or renovation projects, while commercial customers can engage the business for ongoing waste-management needs, including the collection and handling of garden and organic waste. Based in Grootfontein Country Estates, the company serves customers across the surrounding area with this combined refuse-removal, recycling and skip-bin service.

de-beer-assessors-les-marais.description: De Beer Assessors is an insurance-loss-assessment business operating from 238 Fred Nicholson Street in Pretoria. The firm specialises in assessing insured losses and handling related claims matters, working on behalf of or in connection with insurance policyholders, insurers, businesses and property owners who need a professional assessment of an insured loss. This typically involves inspecting damaged property or vehicles and preparing assessments that insurers and policyholders can rely on when settling a claim. The business serves clients across the greater Pretoria area who require this kind of independent loss-assessment service as part of the insurance-claims process. By focusing specifically on insured-loss assessment rather than offering broader insurance brokering or underwriting services, De Beer Assessors occupies a specialised niche within the insurance-claims chain, supporting the accurate and professional evaluation of losses reported by policyholders and property owners. The firm continues to operate from its Fred Nicholson Street premises, serving the local Pretoria market from this base.

mopani-pharmacy-monument-park-pretoria-m.description: Mopani Pharmacy Monument Park is an independent community pharmacy located in Monument Park Shopping Centre, serving Monument Park and the surrounding area. The pharmacy dispenses prescription and over-the-counter medication, and its pharmacists provide advice on treatment and medicine use. An on-site clinic extends services beyond dispensing, offering vaccinations, pregnancy tests, HIV screening and counselling, and family planning services. The clinic also monitors blood pressure, cholesterol and glucose levels, and conducts Discovery Vitality health screening tests. Medicine delivery is available for patients who are unable to collect prescriptions in person. Mopani Pharmacy Monument Park has been part of the local Monument Park community for more than 30 years, building a long-standing relationship with residents and families who rely on it for everyday health needs. Its combination of dispensing and clinic services makes it a convenient first point of contact for routine healthcare, from managing chronic conditions to preventative screening, without the need to travel to a separate clinic or hospital. The pharmacy continues to operate from its established location within the shopping centre, remaining accessible to the patients and families it has served for decades.

mulimisa-consulting-pty-ltd-heuwelsig-es.description: Mulimisa Consulting (Pty) Ltd is a business-management consulting firm operating from Heuwelsig Estate, Centurion. Registered in South Africa and incorporated in 2012, the company provides organisational and management consulting services to entrepreneurs and established businesses alike. Its work focuses on business strategy, organisational structure, operational efficiency, compliance and growth, helping clients refine how their businesses are run rather than offering a single fixed service package. Mulimisa Consulting works with businesses at different stages of development, from smaller entrepreneurial ventures seeking guidance on structuring and strategy, to more established companies looking to improve operational performance or meet compliance requirements. The firm's long operating history, dating back over a decade, reflects an ongoing presence in the business-consulting sector. Mulimisa Consulting is currently associated with its Heuwelsig Estate location as its operating base in Centurion, where it continues to provide consulting support to its client base.

multi-layer-trading-926-heatherview.description: Multi Layer Trading 926 is a manufacturing and engineering business based at 106 Orange Road, Rosslyn, Pretoria. The company supplies mining equipment, engineering services and electrical machinery and equipment to customers in the mining, industrial and engineering sectors. Operating from Rosslyn, an established industrial node north of Pretoria, Multi Layer Trading 926 positions itself as a supplier and service provider to businesses that depend on reliable mining and industrial equipment. Its engineering services complement its equipment supply, allowing it to support clients across the full range of mining and industrial machinery needs, from supply through to related engineering work. The company is listed by the Capital City Business Chamber under manufacturing, mining equipment and engineering services categories, reflecting its established presence within the regional industrial and mining supply sector. Multi Layer Trading 926 serves as a point of contact for mining, industrial and engineering customers seeking equipment and engineering support in the greater Pretoria and Rosslyn area.

naskar-spares-accessories-villieria.description: Naskar Spares & Accessories is a family-operated vehicle parts business established in 1978, trading from 1163 Hertzog Street, Waverley, Pretoria. The business supplies vehicle spares, tools, additives, accessories and oils to both retail and trade customers, including private vehicle owners and workshops. Naskar holds a stock range of more than 57,000 line items, and where a specific part is not held in stock, the business can source it through its supplier network. This combination of a large existing inventory and supplier access allows Naskar to serve a broad range of vehicle makes and models, as well as specialised trade requirements from workshops and other repair businesses. Having operated since 1978, Naskar Spares & Accessories has built decades of experience in the vehicle parts trade, remaining a family-run operation throughout. Its focus on both individual vehicle owners and trade customers makes it a practical option for everyday spares and accessories as well as bulk or specialised orders placed by workshops operating in and around Pretoria.

news-cafe-menlyn.description: News Cafe is a restaurant, café and cocktail bar located at Menlyn Piazza on Lois Avenue, Menlyn. The venue combines dining with entertainment-oriented features, offering food and drinks in a setting aimed at adults, diners, groups and nightlife customers. News Cafe's Menlyn branch offers outdoor seating, Wi-Fi, takeaway service and on-site parking, making it suited to both casual meals and evening socialising. As part of a restaurant and cocktail-bar format, the venue caters to groups looking for a combination of food, drinks and atmosphere in one location, rather than a single-purpose restaurant or bar. Its position within Menlyn Piazza places it within one of Pretoria's established retail and entertainment precincts, giving patrons convenient access alongside other shops and venues in the area. News Cafe Menlyn serves diners and groups seeking a dining-and-entertainment experience that extends into the evening, supported by amenities such as parking and takeaway options for those not dining in.

nn-metals-rosslyn-pty-ltd-akasia.description: NN Metals Rosslyn Pty Ltd is a metal-recycling and waste-management operation based in Rosslyn, Pretoria, one of several Gauteng locations operated by NN Metals alongside its Waltloo head office and its Koedoespoort operation. The company collects and recycles both ferrous and non-ferrous metals for industrial and commercial customers, supported by its own transport and logistics capacity. Its services extend beyond recycling to total waste management, metal brokerage, the sale of new steel, demolition and dismantling work, site rehabilitation, and safe destruction services. This broad service range allows NN Metals Rosslyn to act as a single point of contact for businesses needing to manage scrap metal, industrial waste or decommissioned structures and equipment. Beyond Gauteng, NN Metals' wider footprint extends into North West, Limpopo, Botswana and Namibia, giving the Rosslyn operation access to a larger group network and resources. Industrial and commercial clients in and around Rosslyn can rely on NN Metals for recycling, logistics and waste-management needs handled by an established, multi-site operator.

noviskin-muckleneuk.description: Noviskin is a dermatology and aesthetic clinic located at 199 Bronkhorst Street, corner Tram Street, Nieuw Muckleneuk, Pretoria. The clinic provides medical dermatology services, treating conditions such as acne, eczema, psoriasis, rosacea, vitiligo and sun damage, as well as skin cancers, and offers mole mapping and skin-cancer checks. Alongside its medical dermatology work, Noviskin also provides aesthetic treatments, including chemical peels, microneedling, skin rejuvenation, anti-ageing treatments and laser treatments. This dual focus allows the clinic to serve both patients seeking treatment for diagnosed skin conditions and clients looking for aesthetic skin treatments, within a single practice. Its location on Bronkhorst Street places it in Nieuw Muckleneuk, an established medical and professional area of Pretoria. Noviskin's combination of medical dermatology and aesthetic services gives patients access to a broad range of skin-related care, from the diagnosis and treatment of skin disease to cosmetic and anti-ageing procedures, without needing to visit separate practices for each type of treatment.

nthatisithato-properties-hesteapark.description: NthatisiThato Properties is a residential real-estate agency based at 59 Vaalboskat Street, Hesteapark, Akasia. The agency facilitates the buying, selling and renting of residential property, with its work focused specifically on the Hesteapark area and the broader northern Pretoria and Akasia region. This local focus allows NthatisiThato Properties to build detailed knowledge of the Hesteapark property market, serving home buyers, sellers, landlords and tenants looking for guidance on property transactions within this specific part of Pretoria. By concentrating its services on a defined geographic area rather than operating across the wider city, the agency positions itself as a specialist resource for clients with property interests in Hesteapark and the surrounding northern Pretoria suburbs. NthatisiThato Properties serves as a point of contact for residents and prospective buyers navigating the local housing market, whether they are looking to purchase a home, sell an existing property, or find rental accommodation in the Akasia area.

oasis-water-centurion-lyttelton-lyttelto.description: Oasis Water Centurion (Lyttelton) is a purified-water retail and refill business operating from the Highland Shopping Centre, located at the Superspar on 143 Rabie Street, Lyttelton, Centurion. As part of the broader Oasis Water franchise network, the branch provides purified water to households, individuals and businesses in the Lyttelton area, offering both retail purchase and refill options for customers who bring their own containers. Its location within a shopping centre anchored by a Superspar supermarket makes it a convenient stop for local residents already shopping in the area, allowing water refills to be combined with other errands. The branch serves the everyday purified-water needs of the Lyttelton community, from individual households topping up drinking water supplies to small businesses sourcing water for their premises. Operating under the established Oasis Water franchise model, the Lyttelton branch benefits from a recognised brand and consistent water-purification standards applied across its retail and refill service.

offtek-cc-valhalla.description: Offtek cc is a stationery and office-supplies retailer located at 25 Hekla Road, Valhalla, Pretoria. The business supplies stationery, printing equipment and rubber stamps to a customer base that includes individuals, schools, offices and businesses. Offtek offers both delivery and in-store collection, giving customers flexibility in how they receive their orders, whether placing a small individual order or supplying an office or school with ongoing stationery needs. The business is also listed by Croxley South Africa as a stationery stockist in Valhalla, reflecting its role as a recognised supplier of established stationery brands in the area. Offtek's product range covering stationery, printing equipment and rubber stamps makes it a practical single supplier for offices and schools needing a range of supplies from one location, rather than sourcing different items from multiple retailers. Based in Valhalla, Pretoria 0185, the business serves customers across the surrounding area who require stationery and office supplies with the convenience of delivery or collection.

p-m-mahlangu-attorneys-sable-hills-water.description: P.M Mahlangu Attorneys is a legal practice operating from 507 Spuy Street, Pretoria. The firm provides attorney and legal services to both individual and business clients. As a practising law firm based in central Pretoria, P.M Mahlangu Attorneys offers clients access to legal representation and advice within the city, serving individuals and businesses that require legal services in a range of matters. Its location on Spuy Street places the practice within reach of Pretoria's legal and administrative precinct, a common base for law firms serving clients who need to attend to legal matters connected to the city's courts and government offices. P.M Mahlangu Attorneys serves as a point of contact for clients seeking legal assistance, offering the kind of general attorney services that individuals and businesses in the area typically require, from day-to-day legal queries to formal legal representation.

pam-golding-properties-copperleaf-copper.description: Pam Golding Properties Copperleaf operates from an office at 1197 Shoreacres Crescent, Copperleaf, 0157, serving the Copperleaf and Willow Brook Estate areas. The office provides residential property sales, rentals and related services to buyers, sellers, landlords and tenants with interests in these two estates. As part of the wider Pam Golding Properties network, the Copperleaf office combines the backing of an established national real-estate brand with a specific focus on the local Copperleaf and Willow Brook Estate markets. This dual positioning allows it to offer clients both broad market knowledge and detailed, area-specific expertise when buying, selling, letting or renting residential property. The office's confirmed location and stated service area make it a dedicated local resource for property transactions within Copperleaf and Willow Brook Estate, rather than a general office covering the wider Centurion region. Buyers, sellers, landlords and tenants in these estates can turn to the Copperleaf office for guidance through the full range of residential property services tied to these two specific communities.

papachinos-silverlakes-hazeldean.description: Papachinos Silverlakes is a family and casual-dining restaurant located at the corner of Graham Road and Silver Lakes Road, Tijger Vallei, Pretoria. The restaurant serves Italian-inspired food, including pizza and pasta, alongside other meals, with vegetarian options available on the menu. It offers outdoor seating, accepts reservations, and provides both takeaway and delivery service, making it accessible to customers who prefer to dine in or eat at home. The restaurant's facilities are wheelchair-accessible, broadening its usability for a wide range of customers. Positioned in the Silverlakes area on Graham Road, Papachinos serves families, local residents, groups and casual diners looking for an informal, family-friendly dining option. Its combination of dine-in, takeaway and delivery service, together with a menu that includes vegetarian choices, allows it to accommodate different dining preferences within one restaurant. Papachinos Silverlakes functions as a neighbourhood dining option for residents of Silverlakes and the surrounding Tijger Vallei area, offering casual Italian-inspired meals for everyday family dining.

pgsi-group-hermanstad.description: PGSI Group is an investment and shareholding company based at 444 Taljaard Street, Hermanstad, Pretoria. The group acts as a value-adding Black business partner to operational companies, forming part of a broader group and business ecosystem that includes a number of affiliated companies. PGSI brings expertise in management, operations and Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment (BBBEE) to the businesses it partners with, supporting both the companies it holds a stake in and the wider ecosystem of affiliated businesses. According to the group's own profile, its transformation journey began in 1996, with PGSI Group itself established in 2005 as a Black Equity Owned company. This history positions PGSI as a long-standing player in Black-owned business investment and partnership in South Africa. The group serves businesses and investors seeking a shareholding or operational partner with specific BBBEE and management expertise, as well as the affiliated companies that form part of its broader group structure. PGSI Group's Hermanstad base serves as the operational home for this investment and partnership activity.

phologo-pharmacy-pretoria-central.description: Phologo Pharmacy is a community pharmacy located at 386, corner Francis Baard and Schoeman Street, Pretoria. The pharmacy dispenses prescription medication and over-the-counter medicines, alongside a range of general health essentials. Pharmacists at Phologo Pharmacy provide advice to patients on medication use and general health matters, supporting local residents in managing both everyday health needs and ongoing treatment. As a community-focused pharmacy, Phologo serves local residents and patients who rely on it for routine access to medicines and pharmacist guidance without needing to travel to a larger hospital pharmacy or clinic. Its corner location on Francis Baard and Schoeman Street places it within a busy part of central Pretoria, giving patients convenient access to dispensing services and health essentials. Phologo Pharmacy continues to serve as a local point of access for prescription and over-the-counter medication, combining routine dispensing with pharmacist advice for the patients and residents who make use of its services.

piet-retief-body-builders-donkerhoek.description: Piet Retief Body Builders is a trailer and truck-body manufacturer based at Plot 176, Rhenosterfontein, Donkerhoek. The business manufactures trailers and truck and trailer bodies, along with related trailer-building services, for commercial, agricultural, transport and industrial customers. Operating from an industrial property in the Donkerhoek area, the business is categorised as a trailer manufacturer and is listed within the local Donkerhoek industrial directory at this address. Its focus on custom trailer and body manufacturing allows it to serve customers with specific transport or load-carrying requirements, ranging from agricultural operations needing purpose-built trailers to commercial and industrial businesses requiring custom truck bodies. Piet Retief Body Builders' location within Donkerhoek places it among other industrial and manufacturing operations in the area, consistent with its role as a manufacturer serving the transport and industrial sector. The business continues to serve commercial, agricultural, transport and industrial customers from its established Donkerhoek premises.

pmk-laminates-proclamation-hill.description: PMK Laminates is a flooring and interior-finishes business operating from 646 WF Nkomo Street, Pretoria West, 0183. The business supplies, installs and maintains a wide range of flooring and finishing products, including blinds, carpets, laminate flooring, vinyl, epoxy flooring, artificial grass, parquet, mosaic blocks and solid wood flooring. It works with contractors, designers and homeowners on both new installations and refurbishment projects, and is able to refurbish old parquet flooring through sanding and sealing rather than requiring full replacement. This combination of supply, installation and refurbishment services allows PMK Laminates to serve residential, institutional and commercial customers across a range of project types and budgets, from small home flooring updates to larger commercial or institutional fit-outs. Its product range, spanning soft furnishings such as blinds through to hard flooring finishes like epoxy and solid wood, makes it a broad single-stop supplier for flooring and interior-finish needs in Pretoria West and the surrounding area. The business's WF Nkomo Street premises serves as its base for both retail supply and on-site installation and maintenance work.

postnet-erasmia-erasmia.description: PostNet Erasmia operates from Shop 3, Erasmia Crossing, 514 Main Road, Erasmia, Pretoria. As part of the PostNet franchise network, the branch provides courier services alongside copying and printing, including digital printing and wide-format or plan printing. It also produces business cards, photo prints and name badges, and supplies rubber stamps, stationery and packaging materials. This range of services makes PostNet Erasmia a practical stop for individuals, students, households and businesses needing anything from a single courier parcel to bulk printing or packaging supplies. The branch is enabled for online-shop orders, allowing customers to arrange services without necessarily visiting the store in person. Located within the Erasmia Crossing shopping centre on Main Road, the branch is positioned for easy access by local residents and businesses in the Erasmia area. PostNet Erasmia's combination of courier, printing and stationery services under one roof reflects the broader PostNet model of acting as a one-stop business-services outlet for its local community.

postnet-southdowns-southdowns.description: PostNet Southdowns is located at Shop 37, Southdowns Shopping Centre, corner John Vorster Drive and Karee Road, Irene, Centurion. The branch provides courier and shipping services, along with printing, copying, mailing and other stationery-related business services, serving individuals, households, entrepreneurs and businesses in the Southdowns and Irene area. As part of the established PostNet franchise network, the branch offers customers a single location for sending parcels, printing documents and sourcing stationery and packaging supplies. PostNet Southdowns publishes its trading hours, which include Sunday and public-holiday trading, giving customers access to courier and printing services outside standard weekday business hours. This extended availability makes the branch a convenient option for entrepreneurs and households needing to send or collect parcels, or print documents, over weekends and public holidays when many other business-services outlets are closed. Positioned within the Southdowns Shopping Centre, the branch serves the surrounding Irene and Centurion community with a combination of courier, printing and general business-support services.

pretoria-station-bryntirion.description: Pretoria Station is the city's central railway station, located on Scheiding Street. It serves as a major passenger-rail interchange, connecting Metrorail, Gautrain and intercity rail services, and links Pretoria with Johannesburg and other destinations across Gauteng and South Africa. The station is used daily by commuters and intercity rail passengers, as well as tourists visiting the station for its architectural and historical significance. Pretoria Station originally opened in 1892 and was rebuilt in 1910. The current landmark building was designed by Sir Herbert Baker, one of the architects most closely associated with Pretoria's historic civic architecture, and is recognised as one of the city's important architectural landmarks. Historical research by the University of Pretoria confirms that the Baker-designed building was completed in 1910 and taken into use around 1912. Today, Pretoria Station continues to function as the city's principal rail hub, combining its role as an active transport interchange with its standing as a heritage building of architectural importance, serving commuters, long-distance rail travellers and visitors interested in its history.

attooh-willow-glen.description: attooh! is an authorised financial services provider operating from Unit 1C, Menlyn Woods Office Park, 291 Sprite Avenue, Faerie Glen, Pretoria. Registered as FSP 32189, the company offers a broad range of personal and business financial solutions, including personal and family insurance, short-term insurance, and health and gap cover. It also provides life, disability and income-protection cover, along with investment and retirement-planning services. For businesses, attooh! offers fiduciary services and business-assurance solutions designed to manage company risk. The firm serves individuals and families seeking to protect their assets and plan for the future, as well as business owners and companies looking for tailored insurance, wealth-management and business-risk solutions. By combining short-term and long-term insurance products with investment and retirement planning under one roof, attooh! positions itself as a one-stop financial services partner for clients navigating both personal and commercial financial needs. Operating from its Faerie Glen office, the company serves clients across the greater Pretoria area who require professional guidance on insurance, financial planning and risk management, backed by its status as a licensed and authorised financial services provider.

auto-sound-engineering-koedoespoort.description: Auto Sound Engineering is a car-audio and automotive-entertainment business located at 19 Eland Street, Koedoespoort, Pretoria. The business specialises in car-audio and in-vehicle entertainment equipment, supplying and installing sound and entertainment systems for vehicles. It is listed under the car audio and entertainment equipment category, reflecting its focus on this niche within the automotive aftermarket sector. Auto Sound Engineering serves vehicle owners in the Koedoespoort and wider Pretoria area who are looking to upgrade or install car-audio and in-vehicle entertainment equipment. Customers can expect a business focused specifically on automotive sound and entertainment solutions, operating from its Koedoespoort premises within Pretoria's industrial precinct, an area home to a number of automotive-related suppliers and service providers catering to vehicle owners across the region.

axony-office-furniture-klerksoord.description: Axony Office Furniture is a manufacturer of office furniture based at 46 Robyn Street, Klerksoord, Pretoria. The company produces a wide range of wooden office furniture, including desks, boardroom furniture, reception counters, filing cabinets, cupboards and workstations, all manufactured locally at its Klerksoord facility. Its production team brings more than 20 years of experience in the furniture-manufacturing industry, and the company backs its products with a five-year guarantee against manufacturing defects. Axony has supplied and installed furniture for government departments as well as corporate clients, reflecting a track record that spans both the public and private sectors. The business serves a broad client base, including businesses, government departments, offices and furniture dealers seeking office and educational furniture solutions. From standard workstations to custom boardroom and reception furniture, Axony positions itself as a local manufacturer capable of fitting out offices and institutions at scale. Organisations in need of durable, locally produced wooden office furniture, backed by a multi-year defect guarantee and a production team with decades of combined industry experience, can source a full office-furniture range directly from this Klerksoord-based manufacturer.

bakone-consulting-engineers-constantia-p.description: BAKONE CONSULTING ENGINEERS is a multidisciplinary civil-engineering consultancy operating from 581 Mendelssohn Street, Constantia Park, Pretoria. The firm provides professional civil-engineering services to clients requiring infrastructure expertise, including government bodies, municipalities, construction companies and infrastructure developers. A government tender document has identified BAKONE at this Constantia Park address acting as the employer's agent on a municipal infrastructure project, confirming the firm's active role in public-sector infrastructure delivery. As a multidisciplinary consultancy, BAKONE is positioned to advise on various aspects of civil-engineering projects, from planning and oversight to the kind of agency role documented in municipal tender processes. The firm's client base spans organisations needing engineering oversight on infrastructure works, including municipalities procuring services for public infrastructure and construction companies executing those projects. Operating from its Constantia Park office, BAKONE serves the greater Pretoria region and beyond, offering civil-engineering consultancy expertise to government and private-sector clients alike who require professional engineering input on infrastructure and municipal development projects.

belegi-workwear-and-industrial-supplies-.description: Belegi Workwear and Industrial Supplies Zambesi is a workwear and industrial-clothing supplier operating from the Zambesi Centre at 192 Sefako Makgatho Drive, Sinoville, Pretoria. The business supplies a wide range of occupational workwear and protective clothing, including leather wear, PVC wear, boiler suits and Conti suits, as well as disposable wear, dust coats, freezer wear, security clothing, rainwear and aprons, alongside related accessories. It serves businesses, industrial workers, security companies and construction companies across the region who require protective and occupational clothing for their staff. In addition to its Sinoville branch, Belegi operates further branches in Centurion, Germiston and Rosslyn, giving it a footprint across several industrial and commercial hubs in and around Gauteng. This Sinoville location serves customers in the northern Pretoria area who need a reliable local supplier of industrial and protective workwear, from everyday boiler suits to specialised freezer wear and security clothing. Businesses outfitting staff for industrial, construction or security roles can source a broad range of occupational clothing and accessories from this branch.

blue-bridge-construction-buffelsdrift.description: Blue Bridge Construction is a construction company operating from 9C, Waterkloof Rand Shopping Centre, at the corner of Buffelsdrift Street and Rigel Avenue, Erasmusrand, Pretoria. The company provides general construction services to clients in the Erasmusrand area and surrounding Pretoria suburbs. Blue Bridge Construction serves property owners and other construction clients seeking building and construction work, operating from its Erasmusrand base within the Waterkloof Rand Shopping Centre. As a construction business situated in this established residential and commercial node, the company is positioned to serve local property owners who require construction services, drawing on its presence in one of Pretoria's well-known shopping and business precincts. Clients in the area looking for a construction company based in Erasmusrand can find Blue Bridge Construction at this Waterkloof Rand Shopping Centre address, which serves as its base of operations for building and construction work in the surrounding suburbs.

bpd-advertising-louwlardia.description: BPD Advertising is an advertising and marketing studio based at 7 Bavaria Road, Louwlardia, Centurion. The studio offers branding services, print materials and tailored marketing campaigns designed to meet the specific needs of its clients. BPD Advertising serves businesses, marketers and other organisations seeking support with branding, advertising, print production and marketing strategy. By combining branding work with print-material production and campaign development, the studio positions itself to handle multiple aspects of a client's marketing needs under one roof. Operating from its Louwlardia base in Centurion, BPD Advertising serves businesses across the greater Pretoria and Centurion area that require a dedicated studio for developing brand identity, producing print collateral and running tailored marketing campaigns. Organisations looking for a local advertising partner to manage branding and marketing execution can turn to this Centurion-based studio for its combined branding, print and campaign-marketing services.

cate-a-bake-factory-shop-villieria-villi.description: Cate-a-Bake Factory Shop Villieria is a baking and catering-supplies retailer located in the Villieria Center on Nico Smith Street, Villieria, Pretoria. The shop sells baking ingredients and catering supplies, along with other products related to baking and food preparation. It is open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:30, and on Saturdays from 08:00 to 13:00. Cate-a-Bake serves a range of customers, including home bakers, baking hobbyists, professional bakers and caterers who need ingredients and supplies for baking and food preparation. Situated within the Villieria Center, the shop provides a convenient local stop for residents and businesses in the Villieria area who require baking ingredients or catering supplies without needing to travel further afield. Whether stocking up for a one-off baking project or sourcing ongoing supplies for a catering business, customers in the area can rely on this factory shop's set trading hours and its focused range of baking and catering products.

centurion-sand-monavoni.description: Centurion Sand, trading as Centurion Sand & Plant, is a building-material and sand supplier based at 104 Theron Street, Monavoni, Centurion. The business supplies sand and other building materials to customers in the Centurion and greater Pretoria area. Centurion Sand & Plant is categorised as a sand supplier and building-material business, serving builders, contractors, landscapers and property owners who require sand and related materials for construction and landscaping projects. Operating from its Monavoni premises, the company serves the local construction trade as well as private property owners undertaking building or landscaping work who need a nearby supplier of sand and building materials. For contractors and landscapers managing projects in the Centurion area, Centurion Sand & Plant offers a dedicated local source of sand and building supplies, positioned to support both small-scale property improvements and larger construction and landscaping contracts.

chery-menlyn.description: Chery Menlyn is an authorised Chery vehicle dealership located at the corner of Garsfontein Road and January Masilela Drive, Waterkloof Glen, Pretoria. As an authorised dealer, the dealership sells new Chery vehicles and provides dealership services to customers in the Menlyn and wider Pretoria area. Chery Menlyn serves private motorists, families and businesses looking to purchase or service Chery vehicles, offering access to the brand's current model range along with the dealership support that comes with an officially authorised outlet. Operating under the Chery brand at this Waterkloof Glen address, the dealership forms part of the manufacturer's official South African dealer network, giving customers in the area a local point of contact for new-vehicle sales and ongoing dealership services. Motorists in and around Menlyn seeking a Chery dealership for vehicle purchases or service needs can visit this Waterkloof Glen location, which operates as part of the broader Chery dealer network serving the Pretoria region.

clicks-pharmacy-northpark-florauna.description: Clicks Pharmacy Northpark is a Clicks pharmacy and health-and-beauty retail store located at Shop 41-43, Northpark Shopping Centre, on the corner of Burger Street and Rachel de Beer Street in Pretoria North. The store offers medicines, vitamins and other health products, alongside cosmetics and personal-care merchandise typical of a Clicks pharmacy outlet. A pharmacy-network listing from June 2026 confirms the branch remains active at this Northpark Shopping Centre location. Clicks Pharmacy Northpark serves individuals and families in the Pretoria North area who need pharmacy services, everyday health products and personal-care and beauty items. As part of the Clicks retail chain, the Northpark branch provides customers with access to a pharmacy counter alongside a broader range of health, beauty and personal-care products under one roof. Residents of Pretoria North and the surrounding area can rely on this Northpark Shopping Centre branch for both prescription and over-the-counter healthcare needs as well as everyday cosmetics and personal-care shopping.

timber-trends-za-the-reeds.description: Timber Trends ZA, based at 369 Panorama Road in The Reeds, Centurion, designs and sells handcrafted, solid-wood furniture for homes and households seeking modern wooden furniture and décor. The range includes console tables, coffee tables, benches, TV stands, and side tables, each built from solid wood and finished with metal accents in a modern, minimalist style. The business caters to individuals and households furnishing living spaces with contemporary wooden pieces, offering a focused product line rather than mass-produced furniture. Customers in Centurion and the wider Pretoria area can view and purchase pieces suited to modern interiors, with an emphasis on craftsmanship and clean, functional design. Timber Trends ZA positions itself within the furniture and home-decor sector, serving shoppers who want distinctive, solid-wood items rather than generic flat-pack alternatives.

tops-at-spar-valhalla-valhalla.description: TOPS at SPAR Valhalla is a liquor store operating alongside the SPAR supermarket at the corner of Shirley Road and Broadway East, Valhalla, Pretoria. The store serves adult customers in the Valhalla area, stocking a range of wines, spirits and beer alongside the attached grocery offering. As part of the TOPS retail liquor chain, it operates under SPAR's broader retail footprint, giving shoppers a combined grocery-and-liquor stop in one location. The store trades Monday to Saturday from 08:00 to 20:00 and Sunday from 09:00 to 13:00, accommodating weekday and weekend shoppers. TOPS at SPAR Valhalla serves local residents and passing customers looking for convenient access to alcoholic beverages alongside their regular grocery shopping, forming part of the retail cluster at the Shirley Road and Broadway East intersection in Valhalla.

totalenergies-eldoraigne-eldoraigne.description: TotalEnergies Eldoraigne is a fuel station located at the corner of Saxby Avenue East and Frederik Avenue in Eldoraigne, Centurion. Operating as part of the TotalEnergies network, the station supplies petrol and diesel to private motorists, commuters and commercial drivers travelling through the Eldoraigne and wider Centurion area. Alongside fuel, it offers forecourt and convenience services, giving customers access to essentials during stops for refuelling. The station operates 24 hours a day, making it available to motorists at any time, including early-morning commuters and late-night travellers. Its location within the Eldoraigne shopping precinct places it conveniently alongside other local retail and services, supporting both everyday fuel needs and the extended, round-the-clock trading that distinguishes it from stations with limited hours. TotalEnergies Eldoraigne forms part of the broader TotalEnergies fuel retail network across South Africa.

tssd-projects-roodeplaat.description: TSSD Projects & Engineering is a steel fabrication and engineering company operating from 25 Karee Street, Pumulani Agricultural Holdings, Roodeplaat, in the Tshwane region. The business specialises in steel fabrication and engineering services, including laser cutting and general metalwork, serving industrial, construction, engineering and commercial clients requiring manufactured steel components and structures. With more than a decade in the sector, TSSD Projects provides fabrication solutions for businesses that need custom metalwork produced to specification, positioning itself as a manufacturing partner for commercial and industrial projects in and around Pretoria. The company's offices operate Monday to Thursday from 07:00 to 17:00 and Friday from 07:00 to 13:00, giving clients defined business hours for enquiries and project coordination. Based in the Roodeplaat area, TSSD Projects serves customers across the engineering and construction sectors who require reliable, cost-focused steel fabrication and laser-cutting capacity.

turn-n-tender-midstream-midstream-estate.description: Turn 'n Tender Midstream is a branch of the Turn 'n Tender steakhouse chain, trading from the Square @ Midstream shopping centre in Midstream Estate. The restaurant serves steaks, grills and South African cuisine alongside a wine selection, operating as a combined restaurant and bar suited to families, couples, groups and business diners. As part of a brand that has operated since 1977, the Midstream branch has received Reader's Choice recognition and a Diners Club wine-list accolade, reflecting its food and wine offering. The restaurant caters to special-occasion diners as well as everyday meals, and offers reservations, catering and function bookings for groups and events. Its position within the Square @ Midstream centre makes it accessible to residents of Midstream Estate and surrounding areas seeking a sit-down steakhouse experience. Turn 'n Tender Midstream combines the established reputation of its parent chain with local branch-level service, offering a full-service dining option for both casual and formal occasions in the Midstream Estate precinct.

vector-cnc-zwavelpoort.description: VECTOR CNC is a Pretoria-based supplier of CNC machining equipment and related manufacturing solutions, operating in the Zwavelpoort area. The business supplies CNC machines, spindles, motors and precision cutting tools to manufacturers, engineering businesses, workshops and other industrial customers. Beyond equipment sales, VECTOR CNC offers custom machine builds, installation, training and technical support, positioning itself as a full-service partner for businesses investing in CNC machining capability. The company operates on an appointment-based showroom model, allowing customers to view equipment and discuss requirements directly with the supplier rather than through a standard walk-in retail setup. VECTOR CNC serves the broader manufacturing and engineering sector in and around Pretoria, supporting workshops and industrial operations that rely on precision cutting and machining technology. Its combination of equipment supply, installation and after-sales training and support makes it a resource for businesses seeking to establish or expand CNC machining operations in the region.

virgin-active-highveld.description: Virgin Active Centurion is a full-service health and fitness club located at the Bylsbridge Promenade Centre on Bloukrans Street in Highveld Extension 13, Centurion. The club offers a fully equipped gym along with personal training services for members seeking individualised fitness guidance. Swimming facilities form part of the offering, including swim coaching for members wanting structured instruction in the pool. Beyond gym and swimming facilities, the club provides access to physiotherapists, biokineticists and dietitians, giving members a broader wellness and rehabilitation support network alongside standard fitness equipment. This combination serves adults and families looking for an all-in-one fitness, swimming, rehabilitation and nutrition destination rather than a gym-only facility. The club operates extended hours, open Monday to Thursday from 05:00 to 21:30, Friday from 05:00 to 21:00, and weekends from 06:00 to 20:00, accommodating early-morning and evening exercisers as well as weekend visitors. Virgin Active Centurion forms part of the national Virgin Active health-club network, bringing its established gym, aquatics and allied-health model to the Byls Bridge area of Centurion.

vivior-laser-beauty-studio-erasmuskloof.description: Vivior Laser & Beauty Studio operates from Shop 24, Castle Walk Centre, 491 Nossob Street, Erasmuskloof, Pretoria. The studio provides laser hair removal, aesthetic treatments, skincare and a range of body and beauty services for individuals seeking professional cosmetic treatments. Its service menu includes body shaping, chemical peels and dermapen microneedling for skin rejuvenation, along with facials, waxing and massage treatments. Clients can also access nail, brow and lash services, making the studio a one-stop destination for both facial and body-focused beauty treatments. The Castle Walk Centre location is wheelchair accessible and offers on-site parking, supporting ease of access for clients across different mobility needs. Vivior Laser & Beauty Studio serves individuals in the Erasmuskloof area and wider Pretoria East seeking laser-based hair removal alongside broader aesthetic and beauty care, combining medical-aesthetic treatments with conventional beauty-salon services under one roof.

vsp-huur-rietvalleirand.description: VSP Huur is a property-management company operating from Unit B10, Jakarandapark, 18 Bell Crescent, Hennopspark, Centurion. The business manages commercial and industrial properties developed within the VSP Group, including industrial factories and mini-factories let to business tenants. VSP Huur serves businesses and commercial or industrial tenants seeking rental space within VSP Group developments, many of which are located in the Centurion area. As the property-management arm of the VSP Group, the company handles the letting and management of industrial and commercial units on behalf of the group's broader property portfolio, giving tenants a direct point of contact for leasing factory and mini-factory space. VSP Huur's role focuses on connecting businesses with suitable industrial and commercial premises within the group's developments, supporting the operational needs of tenants ranging from small enterprises to larger commercial operations across Centurion and the surrounding Tshwane region.

wizard-polyethylene-waltloo.description: Wizard Polyethylene manufactures and supplies polyethylene plastic wrap and other plastic wrapping and packaging products from its premises at 5 Hoy Street, Waltloo, Pretoria. The company produces pallet and shrink wrap in clear, black and custom-coloured polyethylene, manufactured to customer specification for businesses with specific packaging requirements. Its customer base includes businesses requiring plastic wrapping and packaging for goods handling and distribution, as well as bulk buyers needing larger volumes of wrap material. Established in Pretoria for more than 20 years, Wizard Polyethylene has built a long-standing presence in the city's packaging and industrial-supply sector. The Waltloo location places the business within Pretoria's established industrial corridor, convenient for commercial and industrial customers across the city needing reliable access to plastic wrapping materials. Wizard Polyethylene's focus on customisable wrap colours and specifications allows it to serve a range of packaging needs, from standard pallet wrapping to tailored orders for businesses with particular packaging or branding requirements.

zambesi-glass-aluminium-montana-park.description: Zambesi Glass & Aluminium is a family-run business operating since 1997 from 34 Montana Value Centre, Sefako Makgatho Drive, Montana Park, Pretoria. The company supplies and installs glass and aluminium products, including custom shower doors, glazing, aluminium doors, window frames and shopfronts for homes, offices and warehouses. Its offering extends to custom glazing, safety glass, window tinting and patio installations, serving homeowners, businesses and property owners who need glass or aluminium work for residential or commercial properties. As an aluminium and glass supplier, Zambesi Glass & Aluminium handles both new installations and replacement work, covering everything from everyday shower-door and window glazing to shopfront glass and safety-glass applications. The business trades Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:00. Operating from Montana Park for over two decades, Zambesi Glass & Aluminium has established itself within Pretoria's glass and aluminium supply sector, serving a broad customer base across residential, office and warehouse property types in the northern Pretoria area.

zire-fresh-produce-distribution-centre-p.description: Zire Fresh Produce Distribution Centre operates as a fresh-produce distribution business from 904 Haarlem Street, Roseville, Pretoria. The business distributes fresh produce to retailers, businesses and other commercial customers requiring reliable access to fresh fruit and vegetables for resale or commercial use. Address records place the business at this Roseville location from at least 2021 through its most recently recorded operating period, with an independent courier directory separately confirming the same address. Zire Fresh Produce Distribution Centre serves as a link between fresh-produce supply and commercial customers in the Pretoria area, handling the distribution logistics that allow retailers and other businesses to stock fresh produce without managing sourcing and transport themselves. Based in Roseville, the business forms part of Pretoria's wider fresh-produce supply chain, supporting commercial customers who depend on consistent, distribution-level access to fresh fruit and vegetables for their own retail or food-service operations.

abbots-college-centurion.description: Abbots College is a private high school in Centurion offering secondary education from Grade 8 to Grade 12, based in the Highveld Extension 67 area. The school prepares learners for the National Senior Certificate, serving families in Centurion and the surrounding area seeking a private secondary-schooling option. As a Grade 8-12 institution, Abbots College focuses solely on the senior-phase and FET-phase curriculum, positioning itself for learners entering or continuing high-school education rather than offering primary schooling. The Centurion campus serves the Highveld area and nearby suburbs, giving local families access to private secondary education without needing to travel to schools outside the immediate area. Abbots College forms part of Centurion's private-school sector, catering to parents seeking an alternative to public secondary schooling for learners working toward matriculation and the National Senior Certificate.

accenis-it-solutions-pierre-van-ryneveld.description: ACCENIS IT Solutions is an IT and digital-services company based at 20 Corobrick Crescent, Pierre van Ryneveld Park, Centurion. The business provides IT and digital solutions to individuals and businesses, with a focus on web design and development, digital marketing support and related online services. Its offering includes copywriting and content support for client websites, as well as digital business cards and online advertising services for clients wanting to build or strengthen their digital presence. ACCENIS IT Solutions is listed under digital-printing and IT-related business categories, reflecting its position at the intersection of digital services and online marketing support. The company serves clients across Centurion and the broader Pretoria area who need web design, digital marketing or general IT-related support, functioning as a smaller, locally based alternative to larger digital agencies for individuals and businesses seeking practical, affordable digital solutions.

ackermans-heatherview.description: Ackermans at Blaauw Village is a branch of the Ackermans value-fashion retail chain, trading from Shop 1, Blaauw Village, 283 Ben Viljoen Street, Pretoria North. The store sells clothing, footwear and fashion items for women, men and children, serving families and individuals shopping for affordable, everyday fashion. As part of the national Ackermans retail network, the Blaauw Village branch offers the chain's standard range of value-priced clothing and footwear aimed at budget-conscious shoppers across all age groups. The branch trades later than many comparable stores, open Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 20:00 and Saturday from 09:00 to 18:00, remaining closed on Sundays. This extended weekday trading gives shoppers in Pretoria North additional flexibility to shop for clothing and footwear outside standard retail hours. Ackermans at Blaauw Village serves the local Pretoria North community, forming part of the retail offering within the Blaauw Village shopping centre alongside other everyday retail outlets.

aldes-orion-business-brokers-bronberrik.description: Aldes Orion Business Brokers is a business-brokerage agency operating from 108 Lynburn Road, Lynnwood Manor, Pretoria East. The agency facilitates the buying and selling of businesses, small and medium enterprises, and professional practices, serving business owners, entrepreneurs, buyers and investors across the Pretoria area. As part of the established Aldes business-brokerage network, Aldes Orion operates with a team of brokers who manage active mandates for businesses currently listed for sale, connecting sellers with prospective buyers and investors. The agency's services cover the full process of business transactions, from valuing and listing businesses to negotiating sales on behalf of owners looking to exit or transition out of their enterprises. Aldes Orion Business Brokers serves a broad client base in Pretoria East, ranging from individual entrepreneurs selling a single small business to investors seeking to acquire an established professional practice or SME, positioning itself as a specialist intermediary in business sales.

an-metals-hermanstad.description: AN Metals is a scrap-metal recycling and metal-processing business operating from 258 Slegtkamp Street, Hermanstad, Pretoria. The company deals in both ferrous and non-ferrous scrap metals, serving industrial, commercial and private customers who need to sell recyclable metal or require metal-recycling services. AN Metals is a registered member of the Metal Recyclers Association, reflecting its standing within the formal scrap-metal recycling industry. The business is listed under metal-finishing and waste-management categories and is separately identified in trade directories as a scrap-metal buyer, indicating a dual role in both purchasing scrap material and processing it for recycling. Based in Hermanstad, AN Metals serves the greater Pretoria area, providing an outlet for industrial operations with metal waste, commercial businesses looking to offload scrap material, and private individuals seeking to sell recyclable metal. Its membership in the Metal Recyclers Association gives customers added assurance of compliance with industry recycling standards.

anderson-concrete-works-pty-ltd-olievenh.description: Anderson Concrete Works is a concreting and construction contractor operating in the Centurion area, specialising in concrete work and residential construction and renovation projects. The business serves homeowners and other property owners needing concrete-based construction or renovation work done on their properties. Its services include building outdoor living spaces using face-brick, concrete-and-wood and concrete-and-cladding combinations, along with general concrete finishing work. Anderson Concrete Works holds NHBRC certification, giving customers assurance that its building work meets the National Home Builders Registration Council's standards for residential construction. With close to a decade of experience, the company has built a track record of completed residential renovation projects in and around Centurion, as confirmed by customer project records. Anderson Concrete Works serves homeowners looking to add or upgrade outdoor living areas, as well as property owners undertaking broader renovation or construction work requiring concrete expertise.

arlis-accounting-pty-ltd-wierdapark.description: Arlis Accounting is an outsourced accounting and finance practice headquartered at 21 Estcourt Avenue, Wierdapark, Centurion. Founded in 2010, the firm provides bookkeeping, payroll, tax planning, budgeting and cash-flow management services, along with management reporting, business consulting, company secretarial work and broader business-advisory support. Arlis Accounting primarily serves small businesses that need an outsourced finance and accounting function but do not require, or cannot justify, an in-house finance department. Its service model is built around providing a full suite of financial and compliance functions for a monthly fee, giving small-business clients predictable access to accounting, payroll and tax expertise without hiring dedicated internal staff. Beyond core bookkeeping and payroll, the firm's business-advisory and company-secretarial services extend its role into broader compliance and strategic support for growing businesses. Based in Wierdapark, Centurion, Arlis Accounting has operated for well over a decade, serving small businesses across the Centurion and wider Pretoria area that need reliable, outsourced financial management.

psol-southdowns.description: PSOL, trading as Prasper Solutions, is an IT and business-solutions company based on the Ground Floor of Southdowns Ridge Office Park, on the corner of John Vorster and Nellmapius Drive, in Centurion's Southdowns precinct. The company provides business consulting alongside software and application development, application support and maintenance, DevOps, and the design and build of web and mobile applications. Its services extend to cloud solutions, including cloud migration and ongoing cloud management, enterprise architecture, API integrations, software testing, and the modernisation and optimisation of existing business applications. PSOL works with small, medium and large businesses and organisations, including clients outside South Africa, and lists major South African banks and companies among its customers. By its own account, the company has worked with over 100 customers across more than 80 products and 50 resources, accumulating in excess of 49,000 working hours on client projects. From its Centurion office, PSOL positions itself as a technology partner supporting organisations through the full lifecycle of application development, from initial build through to long-term support and modernisation.

rhk-water-rooihuiskraal.description: RHK Water is a water-purification business located at 100 Maraboe Avenue, on the corner of Maraboe and Uitsig in Rooihuiskraal, Centurion. The company supplies purified drinking water to households, individuals and other local customers in the surrounding area. Operating as a dedicated water-purification outlet, RHK Water serves the local community with trading hours from Monday to Friday 08:00 to 18:00, Saturday 08:00 to 14:00, and Sunday 09:00 to 13:00, giving customers several opportunities each week to collect purified water at times that suit a range of schedules. As a neighbourhood supplier, RHK Water focuses on providing a reliable, accessible source of purified drinking water for residents of Rooihuiskraal and nearby parts of Centurion, functioning as a convenient, local alternative to tap water for everyday household use and for individuals wanting a dedicated purified-water source close to home.

ring-mobile-pty-ltd-montana-park.description: Ring Mobile (Pty) Ltd, trading as Telsys Communications Mpumalanga BK t/a Ringmobile, provides internet-based telephone services from its Montana Park premises at 905 Braam Pretorius Street, Pretoria. The company offers CloudPBX and VoIP solutions that let home users and businesses make and receive calls over their existing internet connection, with a full range of PBX features built in. Customers can choose between flexible prepaid, debit order or post-paid calling plans, allowing both households and organisations to select a billing arrangement that suits their calling patterns without being tied to a fixed monthly subscription. Ring Mobile positions its service as a flexible alternative to traditional landline telephony, aimed at businesses wanting a scalable office phone system as well as home users wanting an affordable way to make calls. The company's Montana Park office operates Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:00.

rrr-rams-holdings-pty-ltd-lotus-gardens.description: RRR Rams Holdings (Pty) Ltd is a waste-management company headquartered at 76 Makhosionke Street in Lotus Gardens, Pretoria. Founded in 2016, the company provides commercial and industrial waste collection, recycling and waste-logistics services to businesses and industrial customers. Beyond waste management, RRR Rams Holdings offers a broader range of support services, including cleaning, transport, general maintenance, garden and landscaping work, construction-related services, and supply services, positioning itself as a multi-service provider for commercial and industrial clients. While the company's marketing has at times emphasised its presence and project work in the greater Johannesburg area, its own published information confirms Lotus Gardens as its head office, and the company lists Pretoria as its headquarters location. From this base, RRR Rams Holdings serves businesses across Gauteng that require combined waste, recycling and facilities-support services, bringing together logistics, environmental and maintenance capabilities under a single provider.

sello-b-letsoalo-attorneys-inc-eloffsdal.description: Sello B Letsoalo Attorneys Inc. is a legal practice based at 609 Paul Kruger Street in Eloffsdal, Pretoria, offering attorney and legal-representation services to individuals, families and businesses. The firm's Eloffsdal address is confirmed by the Legal Practice Council's 2026 National Wills Week listing, which includes the practice among participating firms at this location, and is independently corroborated by earlier Government Gazette records showing the same Paul Kruger Street address. Operating from this long-established Pretoria base, the firm provides legal representation and advice to clients across a range of civil and personal legal matters, serving the Eloffsdal community and surrounding areas of Pretoria. Its participation in National Wills Week reflects a practice area that includes wills and estate-related legal services, alongside the firm's general legal-practice work for individual, family and business clients in the area.
