setsolar-pretoria-eldorette.description: setsolar Pretoria is a solar-energy installer operating from 387 Van der Hoff Road and Elsa Street in the Hermanstad and Eldorette area of Pretoria. The business forms part of the broader SetSolar brand, which was founded in 2007 and has since grown its operations into the Gauteng market, with the Pretoria and Centurion operation functioning as a franchise of that group. setsolar Pretoria supplies and installs solar-energy and power-backup systems for both residential and commercial customers, offering grid-tied systems that remain connected to the municipal grid as well as grid-independent systems for full off-grid backup power, with installation capacities ranging from roughly 3kW for smaller homes up to 100kW for larger commercial sites. The company serves homeowners seeking backup power during load-shedding as well as businesses wanting renewable energy and electricity-backup solutions. Across its Gauteng operations, the SetSolar brand has completed more than 1,155 solar installations, reflecting an established track record in the regional solar-installation market that includes this Pretoria branch.

somalogic-laser-clinic-waterkloof.description: Somalogic Laser Clinic is a laser and aesthetic treatment clinic located at Suite 204, Brooklyn Medpark, on the corner of Olivier and Jan Shoba Streets in Brooklyn, Pretoria. The clinic offers a range of laser and IPL treatments, including laser hair removal, laser vein removal and laser treatment for nail fungus, alongside IPL therapy for sun damage and general skin rejuvenation. Its aesthetic offering extends to skin facials, waxing and sugaring hair-removal services, as well as manicures, pedicures, and lash and brow treatments. The clinic serves clients seeking a combination of medical-grade laser treatments and more conventional beauty services under one roof, from hair and vein removal to everyday skin and nail care. Operating from its Brooklyn Medpark suite, Somalogic positions itself as a specialist in laser-based aesthetic treatments for skin and hair concerns, serving Pretoria-area clients looking for non-surgical cosmetic and grooming treatments.

spares-wise-east-lynne-east-lynne.description: Spares Wise East Lynne is an aftermarket motor-spares retailer based at 171 Stormvoel Road in East Lynne, Pretoria. The store sells replacement vehicle parts and car accessories to private vehicle owners, everyday motorists and workshops in the surrounding area. Customers can buy parts directly in-store, arrange in-store pickup after ordering, or have parts delivered, with the branch offering same-day delivery as well as delivery to off-site locations for customers who cannot collect in person. This combination of in-store purchasing, pickup and flexible delivery options is aimed at making it easier for both individual vehicle owners and repair workshops to source replacement parts quickly, whether for routine maintenance or more urgent repairs. As a neighbourhood motor-spares outlet, Spares Wise East Lynne serves the East Lynne community and surrounding parts of Pretoria, providing a local alternative to dealership parts counters for motorists needing aftermarket components for their vehicles.

studio-cut-edge-silverton-salieshoek.description: Studio Cut & Edge Silverton operates from 237 Roberts Street in Silverton, Pretoria, supplying wood-based boards and offering cut-and-edge processing services for customers planning kitchens, cabinetry and other furniture projects. The business works from customised cut lists and produces 3D designs and spatial-planning layouts to help customers visualise and plan their cabinetry or furniture projects before boards are cut and edged to size. In addition to board-cutting services, Studio Cut & Edge Silverton offers granite installations and kitchen and cabinetry installation, giving customers a combined supply-and-installation option for kitchen and furniture projects. The business serves homeowners undertaking home-renovation projects, as well as contractors and interior and design professionals who need cut-to-size boards and edging work for client projects. Studio Cut & Edge Silverton trades from its Silverton premises on weekdays and Saturdays, and is independently listed by Blum South Africa as a distributor operating from the same Roberts Street address, reflecting its established position as a supplier for cabinetry and furniture-making materials in the Pretoria area.

sungardens-retail-store-willow-glen.description: Sungardens Retail Store is a charity shop located at 18 Twig Street in Lynnwood Glen, Pretoria, operated in support of Sungardens Palliative Care, a Pretoria-based hospice. The store sells donated clothing, books, household goods and other second-hand items to members of the public, with proceeds from sales going towards funding Sungardens' palliative-care services. Shoppers can browse a changing stock of pre-owned clothing, reading material and household items, while members of the community are also able to donate their own used clothing, books and household goods to the store for resale. By combining affordable second-hand shopping with charitable fundraising, Sungardens Retail Store gives the public a way to support local hospice care through everyday shopping or donating items they no longer need. The shop serves bargain-seeking shoppers in the Lynnwood Glen area as well as donors wanting to contribute directly to Sungardens Palliative Care's work in Pretoria.

superspar-saxby-eldoraigne.description: SUPERSPAR Saxby is a full-service supermarket located at 1033 Saxby Avenue in the Eldoraigne Village Shopping Centre, Eldoraigne, Centurion. As part of the SPAR group, the store offers a complete grocery range alongside fresh produce, an in-store bakery, and a butchery counter for fresh meat. Prepared and ready-to-eat foods are available for shoppers wanting convenient meal options, including the store's own Saxby Sizzle braai counter for freshly grilled food, while the on-site Bean Tree Cafe gives customers a place to sit down for coffee and light meals while shopping. SUPERSPAR Saxby serves households and residents across Eldoraigne and the surrounding Centurion area, functioning as a neighbourhood supermarket for groceries, fresh food and quick meals. The store trades daily from 07:00 to 20:00, giving shoppers a wide window for grocery runs throughout the week, including weekends. Positioned within the Eldoraigne Village Shopping Centre, SUPERSPAR Saxby forms part of the local retail hub serving this part of Centurion.

the-courier-guy-shell-clubview-garage-cl.description: The Courier Guy Shell Clubview Garage is a parcel collection and courier drop-off point situated at the Shell garage on Old Johannesburg Road in Clubview, Centurion. The point allows individuals and businesses in the Clubview area to send and collect parcels without needing a courier to deliver directly to a home or office address. Customers can drop off parcels at this location for onward delivery by The Courier Guy, or collect parcels that have been sent to this point for them to pick up at a convenient time. By operating from an existing Shell garage, the point offers extended accessibility for customers in Clubview and the surrounding parts of Centurion who are passing a familiar, easily located fuel station rather than needing to find a separate, dedicated courier branch. This Clubview location serves as one of the garage-based collection points the courier company uses to extend its reach into residential and business areas around Centurion.

coombe-commercial-incorporated-willow-pa.description: Coombe Commercial Incorporated is a law firm based in Willow Park Manor, Pretoria, focusing on commercial and corporate legal services. The firm provides legal representation and advisory work for businesses, companies and individuals involved in commercial transactions, contracts and corporate matters. It has been identified in legal-directory and Government Gazette records, as well as in recent High Court proceedings, as acting attorneys in Pretoria-based commercial matters, reflecting an active legal practice in the city. The firm operates from premises within the N4 Gateway Industrial Park in Western Gate, Willow Park Manor. Coombe Commercial Incorporated serves property owners, business owners and individuals who require commercial and corporate legal representation, including guidance on business transactions, contractual disputes and other corporate legal needs. As a firm centred on commercial law, it positions itself as a resource for Pretoria-based businesses seeking legal support specific to commercial and corporate operations, rather than general consumer legal services. Clients turn to the firm for its focus on business-oriented legal work within the greater Pretoria area.

copperleaf-cafe-copperleaf-golf-estate.description: Copperleaf Cafe is the café and restaurant facility at Copperleaf Golf and Country Estate, located on Ernie Els Boulevard in Mnandi, Centurion. It operates as part of the estate's clubhouse amenities, offering a café-style menu that includes breakfasts, pizzas, burgers, steaks, sandwiches and other light meals. The venue serves golf-estate residents, golfers finishing a round, and visitors to the estate, along with families and couples looking for a relaxed meal in a golf-course setting. As the estate's dedicated café and bar facility, Copperleaf Cafe functions as a social hub for the Copperleaf community, providing a casual dining option alongside the estate's golfing and leisure facilities. Its menu is built around approachable, familiar dishes rather than fine dining, suited to golfers between rounds and residents seeking a nearby meal without leaving the estate. The café adds to the lifestyle offering at Copperleaf Golf and Country Estate, complementing the course and clubhouse with a dedicated food and drink venue open to residents and estate visitors alike.

crede-deo-private-school-academy-floraun.description: Crede Deo Private School & Academy is a private secondary school in Florauna, Pretoria North, offering education from Grade 8 through Grade 12. The school also runs a post-Grade-12 GAP programme for learners who have completed matric and want an additional year of preparation before tertiary study or entering the workplace. It operates as a small, private institution focused on secondary-level schooling, serving learners and families in Pretoria's northern suburbs who are looking for a private-school alternative to public education. The school additionally offers hostel and boarding facilities, making it accessible to learners travelling from outside the immediate Pretoria area who need accommodation during the school term. This boarding option broadens its reach beyond local families to include students from other regions wanting to attend a private secondary school in Pretoria. Crede Deo positions itself as a progressive, academically focused environment for Grade 8 to 12 learners, with the GAP year giving school-leavers a structured option for the year following matric.

csgd-construction-amandasig.description: CSGD Construction is a building contractor operating in Amandasig, Pretoria, offering a broad range of construction services for residential and property clients. Its work includes new-build construction, extensions and additions to existing homes, renovations and remodelling projects, as well as other construction tasks such as boundary walls and swimming pools. The company serves homeowners and property owners in the Amandasig area and surrounding parts of Pretoria who need building work carried out, whether starting a new structure from scratch or upgrading an existing property. CSGD Construction's service range spans the full lifecycle of a building project, from initial construction through to later-stage renovations, giving clients a single contractor to approach for various building needs on their property. Its focus on both new builds and renovation work, alongside ancillary projects such as walls and pools, reflects a general building-contractor model suited to residential clients rather than large-scale commercial development. Pretoria homeowners planning construction, extension or renovation work can approach CSGD Construction as a locally based contractor in the Amandasig area.

damelin-city-campus-pretoria-pretoria-ce.description: Damelin City Campus Pretoria is a higher-education and vocational training campus located at the Presidia Building, 255 Paul Kruger Street, in Pretoria's city centre. As part of the Damelin network, the campus offers accredited and other education programmes aimed at preparing students for career-focused qualifications and further study. It serves students and adult learners pursuing higher education, vocational training or career-oriented qualifications in a city-centre setting, providing access to the kind of practical and academic programmes associated with the wider Damelin institution. The campus functions as a local point of access to Damelin's course offerings for people based in or around Pretoria, allowing them to pursue tertiary-level and vocational studies without travelling to other provinces. Damelin City Campus Pretoria caters to school-leavers moving into further study as well as working adults seeking to add qualifications or change career direction through structured, campus-based learning. Its location on Paul Kruger Street places it within Pretoria's central business area, convenient to public transport for commuting students.

danilogo-structures-pty-ltd-boekenhoutsk.description: Danilogo Structures (Pty) Ltd is a steel fabrication and construction company based at 15 Cornelia Road, Zandfontein, near Pretoria. The company designs and builds a wide range of steel structures, including churches, aircraft hangars, warehouses, steel-roof-truss buildings, barns and tool sheds, solar-panel support structures, conveyor and mining-related structures, sports arenas, workshops and factories. This broad structural range allows Danilogo to serve clients across several sectors, including agricultural operations needing barns or storage sheds, industrial and mining clients requiring conveyor or specialised structural steelwork, and construction, commercial and institutional clients commissioning warehouses, factories, workshops or large-span buildings such as churches and sports arenas. Danilogo's capability spans both the fabrication of steel components and the construction of complete structures, positioning it as a contractor able to handle projects from smaller agricultural buildings through to larger industrial and institutional steel structures. Its presence in Zandfontein, on the outskirts of Pretoria, puts it within reach of the surrounding agricultural, mining and industrial areas it serves, as well as Pretoria's broader construction and institutional-building market.

diad-signs-industrial-suppliers-pty-ltd-.description: Diad Signs & Industrial Suppliers is a signage company based at Unit 08, Tomzeil, 275 Maggs Street, in Waltloo, Pretoria. The business supplies and produces signage and related industrial sign products for businesses, organisations and construction or industrial clients across the Pretoria area. Operating from Waltloo, an established industrial and warehousing node, Diad Signs is positioned close to the construction and industrial businesses that make up a large part of its client base. The company has been registered and operating since its incorporation in 2016, with current company records confirming it remains an active, registered business. Diad Signs & Industrial Suppliers serves clients needing signage for commercial premises, construction sites, industrial facilities and other organisational needs, supplying the physical signage and related products required for site identification, branding and safety or informational signage in industrial settings. Its focus on both signage and broader industrial supply needs makes it a point of contact for businesses in Waltloo and the wider Pretoria industrial area looking for sign production and related industrial-supply services.

ds-projects-steelworx-pty-ltd-hesteapark.description: DS Projects & Steelworx (Pty) Ltd is a steelwork and metal-fabrication business operating in the greater Pretoria area. The company carries out fabricated steelwork for residential and construction clients, producing steel components and structures to order for customers in the building and property sector. DS Projects & Steelworx serves homeowners undertaking home-improvement or security-related steelwork, property developers requiring fabricated steel components for larger developments, and construction customers needing metal-fabrication work as part of broader building projects. As a steelwork and fabrication specialist, the business concentrates on producing custom steel items and structures rather than general construction or building work, positioning it as a subcontractor or direct-service provider for steel-related needs within residential and commercial construction. Its client base reflects the range of steelwork demand found in growing residential and development areas around Pretoria, from individual homeowners needing smaller fabricated items to developers and contractors requiring steelwork at a larger project scale. DS Projects & Steelworx operates as a Pretoria-area steel-fabrication business serving this mix of residential, development and construction clients.

edgars-menlyn.description: Edgars is a South African department-store retailer offering clothing, footwear, beauty products, fragrances, accessories and other fashion and lifestyle merchandise. Its Menlyn branch operates within Menlyn Park Shopping Centre, at the corner of Atterbury Road and Lois Avenue in Menlyn, Pretoria, one of the city's major shopping destinations. The store serves individuals and families shopping for clothing, footwear, beauty and fragrance products, along with broader fashion and lifestyle items, functioning as one of the centre's anchor fashion retailers. As part of the established Edgars chain, the Menlyn store carries the same general merchandise mix found across the retailer's South African locations, combining clothing and footwear for men, women and children with beauty counters, fragrances and fashion accessories. Its position within Menlyn Park Shopping Centre places it among a concentration of other retail, dining and lifestyle outlets, making it a convenient stop for shoppers visiting the centre for general fashion and beauty needs. Edgars Menlyn continues to operate as an active store location within the shopping centre, serving the Menlyn area and wider eastern Pretoria.

eli-dor-projects-pty-ltd-sunderland-ridg.description: Eli-Dor Projects (Pty) Ltd is a contract-manufacturing business based at Unit 3, 9 Sesmylspruit Street, in Sunderland Ridge, Pretoria. The company works with steel, plastic and rubber to take products from initial concept through to finished, sale-ready items, offering manufacturing capability across these three material types rather than specialising in just one. This range allows Eli-Dor Projects to serve businesses and manufacturers that need a single contract manufacturer able to handle components or products involving mixed materials, from design and prototyping through to full production runs. Clients typically include companies that have a product concept but lack in-house manufacturing capacity, turning to Eli-Dor Projects for the production, assembly and finishing work needed to bring that product to market. Based in Sunderland Ridge, an established industrial area in Centurion, the company sits within a broader manufacturing and industrial supply-chain cluster, giving it convenient access to other suppliers and industrial clients in the area. Eli-Dor Projects' focus on taking products from concept to completion makes it a practical partner for businesses outsourcing steel, plastic or rubber manufacturing rather than running their own production facilities.

emtelle-pty-ltd-ashley-gardens.description: Emtelle (Pty) Ltd, operating as Emtelle Africa, is an information-technology and ICT infrastructure company based at 137 Edison Crescent in Hennopspark, Centurion. Established in 2013, the company provides a broad range of network and technology infrastructure services, including network cabling, fibre-optic reticulation and splicing, electrical work, and the installation of UPS systems and generators for backup power. Its services also extend to CCTV and access-control systems, HVAC installation, telecommunications infrastructure, fibre-to-the-home rollout, and the supply of IT hardware and network equipment, backed by technical support. Emtelle Africa serves businesses, government organisations and institutions that require end-to-end ICT infrastructure, combining networking, security, power-backup and connectivity services under one provider rather than requiring clients to coordinate multiple specialist suppliers. The company has held South African government contracts covering internet-service-provider and cybersecurity work as well as office-automation solutions, reflecting its capacity to deliver infrastructure projects at an institutional scale. Its combination of electrical, networking and IT-focused services reflects the breadth of ICT infrastructure projects it undertakes for government and corporate clients in the Centurion and greater Pretoria area.

fin-forum-montana-montana-gardens.description: Fin Forum Montana is a commercial retail and office centre located at the corner of Dr Van der Merwe Road and Sefako Makgatho Drive in Montana, Pretoria. The centre forms part of a retail property portfolio and covers approximately 5,850 square metres of retail and office space. It is anchored by financial-services tenants, with ABSA, FNB and Nedbank branches operating within the centre alongside other retail and professional-service businesses. This mix of banking tenants and general retail and office space makes Fin Forum Montana a convenient destination for residents and businesses in the Montana area needing banking services together with other errands in one location. The centre serves local residents, consumers and businesses using its financial-services tenants for everyday banking, as well as customers of its other retail and professional tenants. Positioned within the broader Montana commercial node, Fin Forum Montana functions as a neighbourhood-level commercial centre, combining essential financial services with smaller-scale retail and office tenancies for the surrounding residential area.

florauna-supermarket-florauna.description: Florauna Supermarket is a neighbourhood grocery store located on the corner of West and Brits Street, along Brits Road, in Florauna, Pretoria. The store stocks a full range of everyday grocery items, including bakery products, dairy, fresh vegetables, beverages, toiletries, cleaning products and pet food, alongside other household essentials. It serves local households and consumers in Florauna and the surrounding northern Pretoria suburbs who rely on it for routine grocery shopping close to home. In addition to its grocery catalogue, Florauna Supermarket runs a separate hot-food and takeaway operation, giving customers the option of ready-to-eat meals alongside their regular grocery shopping. This combination of a full grocery range and a takeaway counter positions the store as a convenient, all-in-one stop for both stocking up on household essentials and picking up a quick meal. As a neighbourhood supermarket rather than a large chain store, Florauna Supermarket focuses on serving the day-to-day shopping needs of the local Florauna community, offering the breadth of a general grocery store within a smaller, locally focused format.

jps-moving-dorandia.description: JPS Moving is a Pretoria-based removals company operating from Mountain View, serving homes, offices and businesses across the city and beyond. The company provides local and long-distance moving services, including home removals, office removals and furniture removals, supported by packaging and storage solutions and its own transportation fleet. Clients range from individual households relocating within Pretoria to businesses coordinating office relocations, with the company handling the logistics of packing, loading, transporting and unpacking belongings for each move. JPS Moving offers storage options for customers who need to keep belongings secure between moves, along with packaging materials to protect items in transit. Over fourteen years in operation, the company has grown into a team of around ten staff members who carry out day-to-day moving operations. It is located at 1213 Daniel Street in Mountain View, Pretoria, placing it within reach of surrounding suburbs for both local jobs and moves further afield. JPS Moving's services suit anyone needing a structured, supported move, whether relocating a family home, downsizing, or shifting an office setup, with transportation and storage handled as part of a single service.

junox-projects-cc-kameeldrift.description: Junox Projects CC is a construction and home-improvement contractor based at Plot 286 Loerie Street in Kameeldrift East, Pretoria. The company carries out general building work, renovations and extensions, along with tiling, painting, paving, carpentry, and ceiling and drywall installation for residential and other properties. Alongside its building services, Junox Projects CC also fabricates and installs steel products, including security gates, sliding gates, carports, handrails and fencing, giving it a combined offering across construction and metalwork. With sixteen years in the industry, the company has built up experience across home-improvement and building projects, among them completed renovation work carried out in Rietondale. Junox Projects CC positions itself around the use of qualified tradesmen and backs its work with a workmanship guarantee, aiming to give property owners confidence in the quality of completed jobs. Its services suit homeowners looking for a single contractor able to handle structural building and renovation work as well as finishing trades like tiling and painting, together with steel security and fencing installation. Based in Kameeldrift East, the company serves Pretoria-area clients needing construction, renovation, maintenance or building work of varying scope.

kwikspar-kloofsig-kloofsig.description: KWIKSPAR Kloofsig is a neighbourhood supermarket located at 350 Kruger Avenue in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, serving local residents, households and shoppers in the surrounding area. As a branch of the SPAR group, the store stocks everyday groceries alongside fresh produce, meat and bakery products, giving shoppers a single option for regular household shopping. The in-store bakery produces fresh baked goods, while a dedicated food counter offers prepared, ready-to-eat meals for customers looking for a quicker option alongside their grocery shop. Beyond the shelves, KWIKSPAR Kloofsig also offers a delivery service, allowing customers in Lyttelton Manor and nearby suburbs to have groceries brought to their door rather than shopping in person. The store functions as a convenient, everyday shopping destination for the local community, combining the breadth of a supermarket with the personal service of a neighbourhood store. Its Kruger Avenue location in Centurion makes it an accessible option for residents of Lyttelton Manor and surrounding suburbs needing groceries, fresh produce, meat, baked goods or prepared food close to home.

lemonjack-studios-raslouw.description: Lemonjack Studios is a private recording and events venue associated with the Villaggio Sano property in Raslouw, Centurion. At its centre is a 90-seat, acoustically-treated recording theatre designed for high-quality sound capture, suited to recordings such as choir and piano performances. Alongside the recording theatre, the venue includes a dining lounge with an informal stage, used to host private groups and small events in a relaxed setting. Lemonjack Studios also operates an accommodation offering under the name GuestHouse@LemonJack, extending the property's use beyond recording and events into overnight stays for guests. The venue is used by musicians and recording clients needing a dedicated, acoustically-treated space to capture performances, as well as by private groups and corporate clients booking the dining lounge and stage area for functions. Access is generally arranged for invited guests and booked clients rather than as a walk-in public venue. Independent travel listings place the accommodation side of the property within the luxury and romantic-getaway category, reflecting its character as an intimate, specialised venue rather than a large conference or wedding facility. Located at 276 Poole Avenue in Raslouw, Lemonjack Studios combines recording, private events and guesthouse accommodation on a single property.

lethabo-africa-consulting-akasia.description: Lethabo Africa Consulting is an accounting firm based in Eldorette, Akasia, offering all-round accounting services to individuals and businesses. Founded in 2020, the firm serves clients needing general accounting and financial administration support, functioning as a small, dedicated practice rather than a large corporate firm. Its client base spans individuals managing personal financial affairs as well as small and medium businesses needing ongoing accounting support. As an all-round accounting practice, Lethabo Africa Consulting is positioned to assist with the everyday financial administration tasks that individuals and businesses typically need handled on a regular basis. Operating from 8th John Street in Eldorette, Akasia, the firm serves the greater Akasia and northern Pretoria area, giving local individuals and business owners access to professional accounting support without needing to travel into central Pretoria. With a small team, the practice offers a personal, hands-on approach to client service, an attribute often valued by individuals and small business owners who prefer working directly with their accountant. Lethabo Africa Consulting's offering centres on general accounting services suited to a broad range of individual and business clients in and around Akasia.

likhwane-holdings-shere.description: Likhwane Holdings is a marketing and advertising agency headquartered in Shere, Pretoria, with its primary location at Fountains, Via Firenze, in Lombardy Estate. Founded in 2007, the agency has operated for close to two decades, building up experience across creative strategy, communications and digital marketing for its clients. Likhwane Holdings works with businesses and organisations on branding and campaign-related services, helping clients develop and carry out marketing strategies rather than offering a single, narrow service. Its combination of creative strategy and digital marketing capability allows it to support clients across both the planning and execution of marketing campaigns, from initial branding concepts through to ongoing communications. The agency serves businesses and organisations that need marketing, branding, advertising or communications support, whether for a specific campaign or as an ongoing marketing partner. Based in the Lombardy Estate area of Shere, Likhwane Holdings serves clients across Pretoria and the wider region, drawing on its long operating history in the local marketing and advertising industry. Its established presence since 2007 reflects a track record of continued operation in a competitive sector, positioning the agency as a full-service option for businesses seeking creative, communications and digital marketing support.

liwayway-food-south-africa-pty-ltd-sunde.description: Liwayway Food South Africa (Pty) Ltd manufactures and distributes snack and food products under the Oishi brand from its facility at Unit 7 Barolong Street, in the Icon Industrial Park in Sunderland Ridge, Centurion. The company's product range includes its Oozies line, part of the broader Oishi snack offering sold into the South African market. The Oishi name itself means delicious in Japanese, reflecting the brand's origins, while locally the Oozies range includes a custard-flavoured variant inspired by South Africa's own traditional custard dessert topping, tying an international snack brand to a familiar local flavour. As a food manufacturer, Liwayway Food South Africa supplies its products through multiple channels, reaching retail consumers directly as well as supplying wholesalers, cash-and-carry stores and distributors across South Africa. This distribution model allows Oishi and Oozies products to reach a wide range of retail outlets beyond its own Centurion facility. Operating from the Sunderland Ridge industrial area, the company forms part of the Oishi brand's South African manufacturing and distribution operations, producing snack food for both everyday retail sale and bulk wholesale supply, placing it within a hub of manufacturing and distribution businesses serving the greater Pretoria region.

m-p-s-ceiling-drywall-and-painting-eloff.description: M P S ceiling drywall and painting is a Pretoria-based contractor offering interior and exterior painting services along with ceiling and drywall-related work. The business provides house painting both inside and outside the home, as well as roof painting, giving property owners a single contractor for a range of painting needs. Alongside its painting services, M P S ceiling drywall and painting also carries out ceiling and drywall installation work, combining finishing trades that are often needed together during home renovations or new building work. The business serves homeowners and property owners across Pretoria who need painting or ceiling and drywall work carried out, whether as a standalone job or as part of a broader renovation project. Its combined focus on painting and drywall-related services allows clients to use a single contractor for both the surface finishing and the underlying ceiling or wall work, rather than coordinating separate trades. M P S ceiling drywall and painting is suited to residential clients looking for practical, functional painting and ceiling work built around the everyday maintenance and renovation needs of homeowners in the Pretoria area.

mara-s-slaghuis-bakkery-magalieskruin.description: Mara's Slaghuis & Bakkery is a butchery and bakery located at 195 Braam Pretorius Street in Magalieskruin, Pretoria, serving local households and customers with fresh meat and baked goods under one roof. The butchery side of the business offers a range of meat products, including poultry, beef and pork cuts, alongside biltong and burgers, catering to customers doing a regular meat shop as well as those looking for ready-to-cook options. Its bakery counter adds pies and rolls and other prepared foods, giving customers the option of picking up baked goods and takeaway food alongside their meat order. This combination of butchery and bakery under a single roof makes Mara's Slaghuis & Bakkery a convenient stop for households in Magalieskruin wanting fresh meat, baked goods and prepared meals without visiting separate stores. The business appears in South African meat-industry records dating back to at least 2017, pointing to an established presence in the local butchery trade over a number of years. Serving the Magalieskruin community and surrounding areas, Mara's Slaghuis & Bakkery functions as a neighbourhood butchery and bakery catering to everyday household needs for fresh meat, baked goods and takeaway prepared food.

marius-coertze-attorneys-rietondale.description: Marius Coertze Attorneys is a general legal practice based at 299 Soutpansberg Road in Rietondale, Pretoria. The firm handles criminal-law matters as well as divorce and family-law matters, forming two of its core areas of legal work. Beyond these, the practice offers general legal services more broadly, extending its work into other areas of legal advice and representation. Earlier material on the firm also identifies commercial law and family law among its areas of practice, pointing to a legal practice built around a mix of personal and business-related legal matters rather than a single narrow specialisation. This spread of practice areas allows Marius Coertze Attorneys to assist a range of clients, from individuals facing criminal charges or going through divorce or other family-law disputes, to businesses and individuals needing general legal advice or representation on commercial matters. Based in Rietondale, the firm serves clients across Pretoria needing legal assistance across these areas, offering a general practice rather than focusing on one field of law alone. Clients needing support with criminal defence, family-law disputes, or broader legal advice can turn to Marius Coertze Attorneys as a Rietondale-based practice covering these core areas.
